scope: 原配置注释和配置项名称；不含实际设置值。

units.source: ** For more options check Settings folder **
units.translation: ** 更多选项请查看 Settings 文件夹 **

units.source: Language file you want to use
units.translation: 要使用的语言文件

units.source: Defines if you want to auto download default locale files from github repository
units.translation: 是否自动从 GitHub 仓库下载默认语言文件

units.source: You can disable this if you are using EN or you already have your locale set up and you don't need other languages to be downloaded.
units.translation: 如果使用 EN，或已配置好所需语言且不需要下载其他语言，可以关闭此项。

units.source: Enable or disable the CMI economy in general
units.translation: 开启或关闭 CMI 经济系统

units.source: If CMIInjector is present, this will be set to true automatically
units.translation: 检测到 CMIInjector 时，此项会自动设为 true

units.source: Attention! For economy to work properly with other plugins you will need either an injector or a recompiled Vault version.
units.translation: 注意！要让经济系统与其他插件正常配合，需要安装注入器或重新编译的 Vault。

units.source: You can find both option at top of plugins page
units.translation: 两者均可在插件发布页顶部找到

units.source: ATTENTION! If you disabled CMI economy while server was running, you will need to perform a full server restart for this to take effect and avoid issues when retrieving players' balances.
units.translation: 注意！如果在服务器运行时关闭 CMI 经济系统，必须完整重启服务器才能生效，避免读取玩家余额时出现问题。

units.source: Determines if player needs to confirm money payment by clicking on chat message
units.translation: 玩家是否需要点击聊天消息，确认转账

units.source: Should we allow offline payments. This is primarily for pay command and will not block other payments like receiving money from other plugins
units.translation: 是否允许向离线玩家付款。主要影响 pay 命令，不会阻止从其他插件收款等操作。

units.source: Set to true if you want to log money transfers between players
units.translation: 设为 true，将玩家之间的转账写入日志

units.source: Determines max amount of cheque player can create
units.translation: 玩家可创建支票的最大金额

units.source: Set it to 0 to remove the limit
units.translation: 设为 0 取消限制

units.source: If set to true, the player will be required to hold a piece of paper to create a cheque.
units.translation: 设为 true，玩家创建支票时必须手持一张纸。

units.source: When set to true, the player will be required to have cmi.command.cheque.withdraw permission node to withdraw cheque
units.translation: 设为 true，兑现支票需要 cmi.command.cheque.withdraw 权限

units.source: Should we allow cheque usage in creative mode?
units.translation: 是否允许在创造模式下使用支票

units.source: If you have creative server, keep this at false or players could start duplicating items
units.translation: 创造服请保持 false，否则玩家可能复制物品

units.source: Should we accept old cheque item stacks with non encoded data in them
units.translation: 是否接受未使用编码数据的旧版支票物品

units.source: Keep it set to false for maximum security
units.translation: 为保证安全，保持 false

units.source: When set to true players will be able to make payments by using short amount formats like 10k which results into 10000 and similar
units.translation: 设为 true，允许使用金额缩写付款，例如 10k 表示 10000

units.source: In addition 10.2k will result into 10200
List of suffixes we should accept and what amount they result in.
units.translation: 允许的金额后缀及其对应数值

units.source: Only one letter is acceptable when defining suffix
units.translation: 后缀只能使用一个字母

units.source: When enabled we will preload all players balances in baltop list on server startup
units.translation: 启用后，服务器启动时会预加载所有玩家余额，供 baltop 排行榜使用

units.source: If you have 3rd party economy plugin this might increase initial load times
units.translation: 使用第三方经济插件时，可能增加首次加载时间

units.source: If set to false then baltop will only include newly modified players balances and not all of them
units.translation: 设为 false，baltop 只包含余额刚发生变化的玩家，不会包含全部玩家

units.source: Keep it disabled if you are not using baltop from CMI
units.translation: 不使用 CMI 的 baltop 时，请保持关闭

units.source: List of players to exclude from baltop list
units.translation: 不计入 baltop 排行榜的玩家

units.source: When enabled baltop list will show short money values, like 12.5M instead of 12501234
units.translation: 启用后，baltop 使用金额缩写，例如将 12501234 显示为 12.5M

units.source: List of names to exclude from baltop
units.translation: 不计入 baltop 的名称列表

units.source: Can be used to filter out towny towns
units.translation: 可用于排除 Towny 的城镇账户

units.source: When set to true some fake accounts will be included into baltop list
units.translation: 设为 true，将部分虚拟账户纳入 baltop 排行榜

units.source: This should include some previously marked accounts as fake which have been created for town usage or similar things
units.translation: 包括此前被标记为虚拟账户、用于城镇或类似用途的账户

units.source: Set to 0 or lower to disable this feature
units.translation: 设为 0 或更小的值关闭此功能

units.source: Time in days of player being offline to exclude from being included in balance top list
units.translation: 玩家离线达到多少天后，不再计入余额排行榜

units.source: For full effect this will require server restart
units.translation: 需要重启服务器才能完全生效

units.source: Starting amount of money players will have
units.translation: 玩家的初始余额

units.source: Minimal amount, can go into negative if needed
units.translation: 最低余额，需要时可设为负数

units.source: Maximal amount of money player can have. Set to -1 to disable this limit
units.translation: 玩家余额上限，设为 -1 取消限制

units.source: Defines amount until player can send to another player
units.translation: 玩家单次向其他玩家转账的最低金额

units.source: This can prevent annoying spam some players would want to create by sending tiny amounts of money
units.translation: 可防止玩家反复转账极小金额来刷屏

units.source: Defines if you want to allow payments with fractions
units.translation: 是否允许带小数的转账金额

units.source: if this is disabled then payments will be limited to whole numbers and in case player provides number with fraction we will round number down
units.translation: 关闭后只允许整数金额；输入小数时会向下取整

units.source: Currency symbol to be used when showing balance or similar
units.translation: 显示余额等信息时使用的货币符号

units.source: Format used for displaying money
units.translation: 金额显示格式

units.source: Converts long numbers to short ones, like 12305122 to 12.3m
units.translation: 将长数字缩写，例如将 12305122 显示为 12.3m

units.source: This format is only for amounts which gets defines suffix like '1.23k' while numbers lover than 1k will use MoneyFormat
units.translation: 此格式仅用于带后缀的金额，例如 '1.23k'；小于 1k 的金额使用 MoneyFormat

units.source: Suffixes for short numbers
units.translation: 金额缩写后缀

units.source: Replaces to western format where decimals are separated by , and thousands by . In example 1,000,000.00 changes to 1.000.000,00
units.translation: 改用逗号分隔小数、句点分隔千位的格式，例如将 1,000,000.00 改为 1.000.000,00

units.source: Placing of currency symbol
units.translation: 货币符号的位置

units.source: Taxing for /pay command usage
units.translation: /pay 命令的转账税

units.source: This is only for this specific command at the moment and will not tax other actions
units.translation: 目前仅对这条命令征税，不影响其他操作

units.source: Type of taxing. None, Flat, Percentage
units.translation: 征税类型：None、Flat、Percentage

units.source: Where flat type will deduct specific amount of money for each pay command usage
units.translation: Flat：每次执行 pay 时收取固定金额

units.source: Percentage type will deduct percentage of money for each pay command usage based on transfer amount
units.translation: Percentage：按每次 pay 的转账金额收取一定比例

units.source: Either flat amount or percentage on transaction amount
units.translation: 固定税额或转账金额的百分比

units.source: Percentage is defined between 0 and 100
units.translation: 百分比范围为 0 到 100

units.source: Minimal amount to tax player, mostly used when taxing based on percentage
units.translation: 最低税额，主要用于按比例征税

units.source: Maximal amount to tax player, mostly used when taxing based on percentage
units.translation: 最高税额，主要用于按比例征税

units.source: Set to 0 if you don't want to have max limit
units.translation: 设为 0 不限制最高税额

units.source: When set to true tax will be added on top of transfered amount, so if player transfers 100 and tax is 10 then receiving player receives 100 and sender player looses 110
units.translation: 设为 true，税额在转账金额之外另收。例如转账 100、税额 10，收款人获得 100，付款人扣除 110

units.source: If its set to false tax will be subtracted from transfered amount, so if player transfers 100 and tax is 10 then receiving player receives 90 and sender player pays 100
units.translation: 设为 false，税额从转账金额中扣除。例如转账 100、税额 10，收款人获得 90，付款人扣除 100

units.source: Recommended to keep it at true just to avoid confusion why receiving player got less money
units.translation: 建议保持 true，避免玩家不明白为何实际收款少于转账金额

units.source: Change this to true only if you have issues with drives I/O and you need to save players files in async mode to lower waiting time for mc server
units.translation: 仅在磁盘 I/O 有问题，需要异步保存玩家文件以减少 Minecraft 服务端等待时间时，才设为 true

units.source: Regex used in recognizing public interactive commands used in signs
units.translation: 识别告示牌上公开交互指令的正则表达式

units.source: Default format is [ic:[icName]] in example [ic:trash]
units.translation: 默认格式为 [ic:[icName]]，例如 [ic:trash]

units.source: If you want clean format use regex like: (\[([a-zA-Z0-9]+)\])
units.translation: 若要使用简洁格式，可使用此正则： (\[([a-zA-Z0-9]+)\])

units.source: Sorting of IC list either by distance from you or alphabetically
units.translation: 交互指令列表按与你的距离或按字母顺序排序

units.source: When disabled we wont try to deop fake operator on server starup or unload while at same time disabling asFakeOp! specialized command usage
units.translation: 关闭后，服务器启动或插件卸载时不会撤销虚拟操作员的 OP，同时禁用 asFakeOp! 特殊指令

units.source: When disabled we will not check for possible infinite loops while performing custom alias commands
units.translation: 关闭后，执行自定义别名命令时不会检查可能出现的无限循环

units.source: When this set to true any message sent to console will be strip out of any colors
units.translation: 设为 true，移除所有控制台消息中的颜色

units.source: In case you have mohochrome console, keep this at true
units.translation: 控制台仅支持单色时，保持 true

units.source: Time in seconds we want to give for playes who joins server a immortality state
units.translation: 玩家加入服务器后获得无敌状态的时长，单位为秒

units.source: Set this to 0 to disable
units.translation: 设为 0 关闭

units.source: Max 60 seconds
units.translation: 最多 60 秒

units.source: Enables or disables maintenance mode
units.translation: 开启或关闭维护模式

units.source: Automatically kicks everyone from server when enabling maintenance mode who doesnt have cmi.command.maintenance.bypass permission node
units.translation: 开启维护模式时，自动踢出所有没有 cmi.command.maintenance.bypass 权限的玩家

units.source: When enabled will show bossbar message informing about current maintenance mode being enabled
units.translation: 启用后，通过 Boss 栏提示服务器正处于维护模式

units.source: When this is set to true features like glow color, player collision, name plates will stop working and CMI will avoid doing anything related to player teams
units.translation: 设为 true，发光颜色、玩家碰撞、名称标签等功能会停止工作，CMI 也不再操作玩家队伍

units.source: Enable this if you are experiencing issue with other plugins which utilizes players teams for certain features
units.translation: 与其他使用玩家队伍实现功能的插件冲突时，可开启此项

units.source: When set to true, plugin will check if player can manipulate armor stand by sending fake block place event and checking if any plugin would want to prevent this action
units.translation: 设为 true，通过模拟方块放置事件，检查其他插件是否阻止玩家操作盔甲架

units.source: This can help out to minimize posibility for players to manipulate armor stands when they don't have build permission in area where armorstand is standing
units.translation: 可减少玩家在没有区域建造权限时，仍能操作该区域盔甲架的情况

units.source: Minimal armorstand scale which can be set in armor stand editor
units.translation: 盔甲架编辑器允许设置的最小缩放比例

units.source: This is base min scale, can be overriden with cmi.command.armorstand.scalemin.[value] permission node
units.translation: 基础最小比例，可通过 cmi.command.armorstand.scalemin.[value] 权限覆盖

units.source: Keep in mind that min value will be taken from this setting and permission node if both are set
units.translation: 两者都设置时，取此项与权限所指定数值中的较小值

units.source: Max armorstand scale which can be set in armor stand editor
units.translation: 盔甲架编辑器允许设置的最大缩放比例

units.source: This is base max scale, can be overriden with cmi.command.armorstand.scalemax.[value] permission node
units.translation: 基础最大比例，可通过 cmi.command.armorstand.scalemax.[value] 权限覆盖

units.source: Keep in mind that max value will be taken from this setting and permission node if both are set
units.translation: 两者都设置时，取此项与权限所指定数值中的较大值

units.source: When set to true, the player will be required to have cmi.command.armorstand.template.[templatename] permission node to deploy saved template
units.translation: 设为 true，放置已保存的模板需要 cmi.command.armorstand.template.[templatename] 权限

units.source: In case you don't have GeoIP.dat it will be downloaded automatically on server start. Restart can be needed for it to take effect
units.translation: 缺少 GeoIP.dat 时会在服务器启动时自动下载，可能需要重启后才生效

units.source: In case you don't have GeoLiteCity.dat it will be downloaded automatically on server start. Restart can be needed for it to take effect
units.translation: 缺少 GeoLiteCity.dat 时会在服务器启动时自动下载，可能需要重启后才生效

units.source: When enabled you will see skull owner name in action bar when right clicking it
units.translation: 启用后，右键点击头颅会在动作栏显示其所有者名称

units.source: When enabled you will see beeHive information in action bar when right clicking it
units.translation: 启用后，右键点击蜂箱会在动作栏显示蜂箱信息

units.source: When enabled you will see decorated pot contents information in action bar when right clicking it
units.translation: 启用后，右键点击饰纹陶罐会在动作栏显示其中物品的信息

units.source: Sets indicator when creating elevator signs. Its case insensitive
units.translation: 创建电梯告示牌时使用的标识，不区分大小写

units.source: Defines sign top line by which player will not be able to edit sign with /cmi se command
units.translation: 告示牌首行符合此内容时，不允许玩家通过 /cmi se 编辑

units.source: Defines elevator type. If this is used on second line of sing, then player will be teleported directly in front of it instead of keeping original players x and z coordinates
units.translation: 电梯类型。在告示牌第二行使用此标识时，将玩家传送到牌子正前方，而不是保留原来的 x、z 坐标

units.source: Used to show date in places like mail, checkban, infopage and similar locations
units.translation: 邮件、checkban、infopage 等位置的日期格式

units.source: Used to show date in places like inv gui and similar locations
units.translation: 物品栏界面等位置的日期格式

units.source: Do you want to record sell hand actions into file
units.translation: 是否将 sell hand 操作记录到文件

units.source: When this set to true by using any command, requiring players name, in case plugin cant determine player by given full name, then partial matches from online players will be used. In example: /cmi heal rips can heal player Zrips
units.translation: 设为 true，执行需要玩家名称的命令时，如果找不到完整名称，会尝试匹配在线玩家的部分名称。例如 /cmi heal rips 可以治疗 Zrips

units.source: Useful when you have players with complicated names
units.translation: 适合名称较复杂的玩家

units.source: If you want to prioritize online players when using partial player name enable this setting
units.translation: 使用部分名称匹配时，是否优先选择在线玩家

units.source: Don't forget to enable PartialPlayerName for this to have full effect
units.translation: 需要同时启用 PartialPlayerName 才能完全生效

units.source: Keep in mind that this might block you from accessing offline player with same partial name as some one currently being online
units.translation: 这可能导致名称部分相同的玩家在线时，无法访问对应的离线玩家

units.source: For example offline Luuk might no longer be accessible while Luuk666 is online
units.translation: 例如 Luuk666 在线时，可能无法访问离线玩家 Luuk

units.source: This can be overridden by adding -exa- suffix for a name, so luuk-exa- will return offline player object
units.translation: 可在名称后加 -exa- 强制精确匹配，例如 luuk-exa- 会返回离线玩家对象

units.source: When set to true, commands in help page will be sorted alphabeticaly
units.translation: 设为 true，帮助页中的命令按字母顺序排序

units.source: If set to false, commands will be sorted by priority
units.translation: 设为 false，按优先级排序

units.source: By default we will not allow Rcon type commands, if you have your server properly setup to accept remote console commands safely and you have a need then you can enable it
units.translation: 默认不允许 Rcon 命令。仅在已妥善配置远程控制台且确有需要时开启

units.source: When enabled Rcon feedback message will not include color codes for cleaner display
units.translation: 启用后，Rcon 返回消息不含颜色代码，便于阅读

units.source: Percentage value (1-100) to pick best command match if command cant be found
units.translation: 找不到命令时，用于选择最接近命令的匹配度，范围为 1–100

units.source: Example: /cmi spawnmb will have 87.5% match with /cmi spawnmob
units.translation: 例如 /cmi spawnmb 与 /cmi spawnmob 的匹配度为 87.5%

units.source: Set to 0 to disable
units.translation: 设为 0 关闭

units.source: When set to true, if player enters incorrect command, then command will not gonna be performed
units.translation: 设为 true，玩家输入错误命令时，不执行自动匹配的命令

units.source: But message informing about incorrect usage and best match will be shown in any case
units.translation: 无论如何，都会提示用法错误并显示最接近的命令

units.source: When set to true, commands in help page starting with /cmi will get shortened by hiding base command. Example /cmi back becomes /back
units.translation: 设为 true，隐藏帮助页中命令的 /cmi 前缀，例如将 /cmi back 显示为 /back

units.source: Keep in mind that this is automatic feature if alias or custom alias is set to that command
units.translation: 已为命令设置别名或自定义别名时，会自动使用此功能

units.source: And keep in mind that this is only cosmetic change and will not impact command usage
units.translation: 这只影响显示，不改变命令的实际用法

units.source: When set to true, all players can see missing permission node by hovering over error message
units.translation: 设为 true，所有玩家都能将鼠标移到错误提示上，查看缺少的权限节点

units.source: When set to false only players with cmi.permisiononerror permission node can see missing permission node
units.translation: 设为 false，只有拥有 cmi.permisiononerror 权限的玩家才能查看缺少的权限节点

units.source: Keep in mind that by default players have acces to permission node, so negate it if you want to hide missing permission nodes from them
units.translation: 玩家默认拥有此权限；若要隐藏缺少的权限节点，请将该权限设为否定

units.source: When set to true, each time player tries to use something he doesnthave permission, message will be shown in console
units.translation: 设为 true，玩家尝试执行无权限的操作时，会在控制台显示消息

units.source: Players need to have cmi.safeteleport permision node to be placed in a safe location when teleporting to target location
units.translation: 玩家需要 cmi.safeteleport 权限，传送时才会被放到安全位置

units.source: When true then while checking for safe location, we will try to determin it going down and if it fails, then up from target location
units.translation: 设为 true，检查安全位置时先从目标位置向下搜索，失败后再向上搜索

units.source: When set to false, then first of all location above target location will be checked, then down
units.translation: 设为 false，先检查目标位置上方，再检查下方

units.source: Time in seconds player should be invulnerable after teleporting
units.translation: 传送后玩家的无敌时长，单位为秒

units.source: This will prevent player who teleported to damage others for defined time
units.translation: 在指定时间内，也阻止刚传送的玩家伤害其他玩家

units.source: Set this to 0 if you want to disable it
units.translation: 设为 0 关闭此功能

units.source: Time in seconds player should be invulnerable after teleporting to this world
units.translation: 传送到此世界后玩家的无敌时长，单位为秒

units.source: If world isn't defined then default timer will be used
units.translation: 未单独设置的世界使用默认时长

units.source: Situations where teleport invulnerability gets disabled
units.translation: 以下情况会取消传送后的无敌状态

units.source: Disables if player breaks or places block
units.translation: 玩家破坏或放置方块时取消

units.source: Disables if player interacts with a block or entity
units.translation: 玩家与方块或实体交互时取消

units.source: Set to true if you want to use tp commands as /cmi tp [WhoYouWantToTeleport] [WhereToTeleport] when its false, its /cmi tp [whereToTeleport] [WhoYouWantToTeleport]
units.translation: 设为 true，tp 用法为 /cmi tp [WhoYouWantToTeleport] [WhereToTeleport]；设为 false，用法为 /cmi tp [whereToTeleport] [WhoYouWantToTeleport]

units.source: Applies for tpa, tpahere and tpaall only
units.translation: 仅适用于 tpa、tpahere 和 tpaall

units.source: If set to true then player will be teleported to current player position after accepting teleport request
units.translation: 设为 true，接受传送请求后，传送到目标玩家当前的位置

units.source: If set to false then player will be teleported to player at which teleport request was issued
units.translation: 设为 false，传送到发出请求时目标玩家所在的位置

units.source: Applies for tpahere only
units.translation: 仅适用于 tpahere

units.source: Default distance for jump command. Can be overriden with cmi.command.jump.[amount] permission node
units.translation: jump 命令的默认距离，可通过 cmi.command.jump.[amount] 权限覆盖

units.source: Defines time in seconds for accepting tpa or tpahere requests
units.translation: 接受 tpa 或 tpahere 请求的有效时间，单位为秒

units.source: Defines time in seconds for player being teleported after tpa or tpahere is being accepted

units.translation: 在 1.9+ 服务器上开启或关闭 Boss 栏生命值显示

units.source: Only players with cmi.bossbar.hpbar permission node can see it
units.translation: 只有拥有 cmi.bossbar.hpbar 权限的玩家才能看到

units.source: Permission node is been rechecked no more often than every minute for efficiency
units.translation: 为减少开销，此权限最多每分钟重新检查一次

units.source: List of mob types which will be excluded from hp boss bar
units.translation: 不在生命值 Boss 栏中显示的生物类型

units.source: When set to true players who are banned will get messages modified by CMI instead of seeing vanilla type of message
units.translation: 设为 true，被封禁玩家看到 CMI 修改后的提示，而不是原版提示

units.source: Time in seconds to make player immortal after he respawns
units.translation: 玩家重生后的无敌时长，单位为秒

units.source: Can be used to prevent respawn camping
units.translation: 可用于防止玩家在重生点被反复击杀

units.source: If you want 3rd party plugin to handle player respawning, simply set this to false and reload plugin
units.translation: 若由第三方插件处理重生，将此项设为 false 后重载插件即可

units.source: Defines respawn order if defined world is not present in Specific list
units.translation: 世界未出现在 Specific 列表中时，使用的重生位置优先顺序

units.source: Possible respawn locations: anchor, bedLocation, spawn, homeLocation, worldSpawn, warp![warpName]
units.translation: 可用位置：anchor、bedLocation、spawn、homeLocation、worldSpawn、warp![warpName]

units.source: Spawn is preset spawnlocation with /cmi setspawn command, that location should have RespawnLocation set to true
units.translation: spawn：用 /cmi setspawn 设置的位置，该位置的 RespawnLocation 应为 true

units.source: bedLocation is location set by interacting with bed, BedInteraction should be set to false and players requires cmi.bedhome to set bed location
units.translation: bedLocation：通过与床交互设置的位置。BedInteraction 应设为 false，玩家需要 cmi.bedhome 权限才能设置

units.source: homeLocation is location set by player which is with default (Home) name, if that one doesnt exist then first in the list will be used if possible
units.translation: homeLocation：玩家默认名称为 Home 的家。不存在时，尽可能使用列表中的第一个家

units.source: worldSpawn is location preset to this world, this is not CMI location but default world spawn location
units.translation: worldSpawn：此世界的默认出生点，不是 CMI 设置的出生点

units.source: anchor is location defined by interacting with respawn anchor. This in general will only apply when you die in nether world, otherwise bed location is used
units.translation: anchor：与重生锚交互后设置的位置。通常只在下界死亡时使用，其他情况使用床的位置

units.source: warp![warpName] can be any valid warp you set for players to be teleported, they will bypass any requirements for that warp
units.translation: warp![warpName]：任意有效传送点，传送时绕过该传送点的全部使用要求

units.source: Defines respawn order for defined worlds
units.translation: 指定世界的重生位置优先顺序

units.source: Set respawn priority to [] or to random respawn criteria if you want to leave respawn handling for server or 3rd party plugin
units.translation: 若交由服务端或第三方插件处理重生，将重生优先列表设为 []，或设为随机重生条件

units.source: Default value for hologram view range
units.translation: 全息图的默认可见距离

units.source: This defines from how far holograms will appear for the player or when they will disapear
units.translation: 决定玩家在多远的位置能看到全息图，以及何时隐藏

units.source: Default value for hologram update range
units.translation: 全息图的默认更新距离

units.source: This defines how close player should get for hologram to start updating its text
units.translation: 玩家进入此距离内，全息图才开始更新文字

units.source: Keep it at reasoble numbers as there is no point to update hologram across map
units.translation: 请设置合理范围，没有必要更新地图另一端的全息图

units.source: Defines default update interval in ticks, 20 ticks = 1 second
units.translation: 默认更新间隔，单位为刻；20 刻 = 1 秒

units.source: When value is set to 0 or lower, holograms will not be updated
units.translation: 设为 0 或更小的值时，不更新全息图

units.source: This only applies for holograms with dynamic contents
units.translation: 仅影响包含动态内容的全息图

units.source: Defines default page change interval in ticks
units.translation: 默认翻页间隔，单位为刻

units.source: When value is set to 0 or lower, pages will not be changed
units.translation: 设为 0 或更小的值时，不自动翻页

units.source: Prefix to be used for lines utilizing CText
units.translation: 使用 CText 的行所加的前缀

units.source: This only applies for the sections that have set commands and will not have effect on basic text even with hover text
units.translation: 仅影响设置了命令的部分，不影响普通文字，即使普通文字带悬停提示

units.source: Prefix to be used for lines utilizing CText when you hover over it
units.translation: 使用 CText 的行在鼠标悬停时所加的前缀

units.source: Can be overriden with hologram editor
units.translation: 可在全息图编辑器中单独覆盖

units.source: When set to true votifier votes will be counted for player
units.translation: 设为 true，记录玩家的 Votifier 投票次数

units.source: Number of votes one IP can make in last 24 hours
units.translation: 同一 IP 在过去 24 小时内允许的投票次数

units.source: Set it to 0 to have unlimited amount
units.translation: 设为 0 不限制次数

units.source: Cooldown between votes from same service
units.translation: 同一投票服务的投票冷却时间

units.source: In most cases voting service will have its own cooldown setup
units.translation: 大多数投票服务本身已有冷却限制

units.source: But if you need extra one to prevent rapid voting you can define time in seconds over here
units.translation: 需要额外限制快速重复投票时，可在此填写秒数

units.source: When set to false, commands on sucessfull vote will not be performed
units.translation: 设为 false，成功投票后不执行命令

units.source: Defines commands to be performed when player votes
units.translation: 玩家投票时执行的命令

units.source: Supports specialized commands and placeholders
units.translation: 支持特殊指令和占位符

units.source: [serviceName] variable can be used to insert address
units.translation: 可用 [serviceName] 变量插入服务地址

units.source: Keep it at false if you don't want to give out extra rewards
units.translation: 不想发放额外奖励时，保持 false

units.source: Commands will be performed when player collect determined amount of votes
units.translation: 玩家累计达到指定投票次数后执行的命令

units.source: List of players to be excluded from top voter list
units.translation: 不计入投票排行榜的玩家

units.source: If set to true we will check players rank by his access to rank by permission node and prioritize any rank which has more weight over current one
units.translation: 设为 true，通过权限检查玩家可使用的等级，并优先采用权重高于当前等级的等级

units.source: This means that in case player has access to third rank while recorded one is first one, we will prioritize third one
units.translation: 例如记录的等级为第一级、但玩家有第三级权限时，优先采用第三级

units.source: While this is active using command like /cmi setrank will set players rank to highest one he has access too, so as long as player has permission access to third rank you cant go lower than this,
units.translation: 启用期间，/cmi setrank 等命令会将等级设为玩家有权使用的最高等级；只要仍有第三级权限，就无法降到更低等级

units.source: you will have to remove access to specific rank by removing permission node before trying to derank him
units.translation: 降级前，需要先移除相应等级的权限

units.source: Defines how often in minutes plugin will recalculate players group
units.translation: 重新计算玩家权限组的间隔，单位为分钟

units.source: Keeping it at 0 will disable this feature
units.translation: 设为 0 关闭

units.source: Defines how often in seconds plugin will check for possible player rankups
units.translation: 检查玩家能否晋级的间隔，单位为秒

units.source: Set it to 0 or less to disable auto rankup checks
units.translation: 设为 0 或更小的值，关闭自动晋级检查

units.source: EXPERIMENTAL. When set to true, player rankup checks will be done in async mode
units.translation: 实验性选项：设为 true，异步检查玩家晋级条件

units.source: In case of errors related to this feature being turned on, turn it off and report issue with error log to github
units.translation: 启用后若出现相关错误，请关闭，并携带错误日志向 GitHub 反馈

units.source: Defines how often in seconds each separate player will be checked for rankup
units.translation: 对每名玩家分别检查晋级条件的间隔，单位为秒

units.source: This is different than general check just to avoid couple players ranking up at same time
units.translation: 与全局检查间隔不同，用于避免几名玩家同时晋级

units.source: This also defines how often player will be notified about possible rankup and it will proportionaly increase with each time player get notification to avoid annoying spam in chat
units.translation: 同时决定可晋级提示的间隔；每次提示后，间隔会按比例增加，避免聊天刷屏

units.source: Keep it longer or same as general delay time
units.translation: 应大于或等于全局检查间隔

units.source: Enable or disable progression bar in rank info window
units.translation: 是否在等级信息界面显示进度条

units.source: When set to true, command /cmi ranklist will output ranks from your rankup path which will exclude any rank from different paths or different rankup trees all together
units.translation: 设为 true，/cmi ranklist 只显示当前晋级路线中的等级，排除其他路线和等级树

units.source: When set to false, all set ranks will be shown in the list
units.translation: 设为 false，显示所有已设置的等级

units.source: When set to true requirements which involve time will be shown in short format like '50 hours' instead of '2 days 2 hours'
units.translation: 设为 true，时间要求使用小时格式，例如显示“50 小时”，而不是“2 天 2 小时”

units.source: When OnlyHours set to true you can add minutes to the output message instead of showing fractions. So you can have '5 hours 30 minutes' instead of 5.5hours'
units.translation: OnlyHours 为 true 时，使用分钟补充显示，避免小数，例如显示“5 小时 30 分钟”，而不是“5.5 小时”

units.source: Defines in milliseconds how often to check if player entered Dynamic Sign trigger area
units.translation: 检查玩家是否进入动态告示牌触发区域的间隔，单位为毫秒

units.source: Bigger numbers can help slightly lower server load
units.translation: 数值较大可略微降低服务器负载

units.source: This is not essential to keep in low numbers
units.translation: 无需设置得很小

units.source: Defines list sign top lines which cant be edited with shift right click
units.translation: 告示牌首行符合列表内容时，无法通过潜行右键编辑

units.source: Usually used for preventing shop sign modifications
units.translation: 通常用于防止商店告示牌被修改

units.source: When enabled player needs to be sneaking to edit signs
units.translation: 启用后，必须潜行才能编辑告示牌

units.source: When enabled sign editor will be represented with new Dialog editor introduced in 1.21.7+
units.translation: 启用后，使用 1.21.7+ 新增的对话框编辑器编辑告示牌

units.source: Only for Paper servers
units.translation: 仅适用于 Paper 服务器

units.source: Applies skin to player automatically on his login to server if he doesnt have one already set
units.translation: 玩家登录且尚未设置皮肤时，自动应用皮肤

units.source: This will always set to skin by target player name
units.translation: 始终按目标玩家名称获取皮肤

units.source: Sets player sking to Steve when turning skin off and lets server to handle it
units.translation: 关闭皮肤时，先设为 Steve，再交由服务端处理

units.source: If its false, then skin will be changed to online one
units.translation: 设为 false 时，改用在线获取的皮肤

units.source: Requests from player specific permission for that skin cmi.command.skin.perm.[skinName]
units.translation: 使用指定皮肤需要 cmi.command.skin.perm.[skinName] 权限

units.source: Defines time in minutes how offten we want to update skin information from online Mojang servers
units.translation: 从 Mojang 在线服务器更新皮肤信息的间隔，单位为分钟

units.source: So if you have this set to 1 hour, then player skin information will be updated if player old skin information is older then 1 hour
units.translation: 例如设为 1 小时，已有皮肤信息超过 1 小时后才重新获取

units.source: This only triggers when player joins server or changes skin manually
units.translation: 仅在玩家加入服务器或手动更换皮肤时检查

units.source: Time in minutes for how long we want to keep set allert on player when performing /cmi alert command. Default is 24 hours
units.translation: 执行 /cmi alert 后，对该玩家保留警报的时间，单位为分钟，默认为 24 小时

units.source: When enebled, when player logs in who has alert set on him, staff member will get notification that this player have some notes attached to him
units.translation: 启用后，被标记警报的玩家登录时，提醒管理人员该玩家附有备注

units.source: List of item types not to be removed on ground clean action
units.translation: 清理地面物品时，保留的物品类型

units.source: When set to true, plugin will prevent spaming of same or similar command in short time range. Can be bypased with cmi.commandfilter.bypass permission
units.translation: 设为 true，限制短时间重复执行相同或相似命令。可通过 cmi.commandfilter.bypass 绕过

units.source: How much in percentage command is counted as same
units.translation: 判定为相同命令的相似度百分比

units.source: Defines how often in seconds you can send same/similar commands
units.translation: 重复执行相同或相似命令的间隔，单位为秒

units.source: How many commands you can repeat before stopped for cooldown
units.translation: 触发冷却前允许连续重复的命令次数

units.source: Whitelisted commands to ignore
units.translation: 不受限制的命令白名单

units.source: Commands in this list will not be shown when command spy is enabled for player for security/privacy reasons
units.translation: 出于安全和隐私考虑，命令监视不显示列表中的命令

units.source: This can be bypassed with cmi.command.commandspy.bypass permission node
units.translation: 可通过 cmi.command.commandspy.bypass 权限绕过

units.source: Players without cmi.security.admin will only see commands from this list with command spy feature
units.translation: 没有 cmi.security.admin 权限的玩家，使用命令监视时只能看到此列表中的命令

units.source: Keeping it empty will include all commands except the black listed ones
units.translation: 留空表示显示除黑名单以外的全部命令

units.source: For how long to keep players notes in days
units.translation: 玩家备注的保留时间，单位为天

units.source: For how long to keep players mail in days
units.translation: 玩家邮件的保留时间，单位为天

units.source: Mailing to all players will send mails to players who loged into server in last x days
units.translation: 群发邮件只发送给过去 X 天内登录过的玩家

units.source: How many mails we should keep for each player
units.translation: 每名玩家最多保留的邮件数量

units.source: When email limit is reached oldest one will be removed
units.translation: 达到邮件上限后，移除最早的邮件

units.source: Name of mail sender when command is performed from console
units.translation: 控制台发送邮件时使用的发件人名称

units.source: This name will be used as indicator who sent it and who should receive reply if player responds to it
units.translation: 用于显示发件人；玩家回复时，也会发送给此名称对应的玩家

units.source: For best experience set this value to your staff member responsible for communications with players
units.translation: 建议填写负责与玩家沟通的管理人员名称

units.source: If you have 3rd party plugin changing players display name, set this to false
units.translation: 由第三方插件修改玩家显示名称时，将此项设为 false

units.source: Format of players display name. By default only nick name will be visible, if its set, if not, then players name
units.translation: 玩家显示名称格式。默认显示昵称；未设置昵称时，显示真实玩家名称

units.source: Possible custom varibales: {prefix} {suffix} {nicknameprefix}
units.translation: 可用自定义变量：{prefix} {suffix} {nicknameprefix}

units.source: Supports placeholders
units.translation: 支持占位符

units.source: Defines regex for valid nick name
units.translation: 检查昵称是否合法的正则表达式

units.source: By default only letters and numbers are allowed
units.translation: 默认只允许字母和数字

units.source: If you want to allow any letter from any language use [^\p{L}0-9\-\_]
units.translation: 若允许所有语言的字母，可使用 [^\p{L}0-9\-\_]

units.source: Prevents players to change their nick name to one of defined without permission
units.translation: 没有绕过权限时，禁止将昵称改为列表中的名称

units.source: Use lower case
units.translation: 使用小写

units.source: cmi.command.nick.bypassblacklist
units.translation: cmi.command.nick.bypassblacklist

units.source: to bypass protection against already in use name/nickname use cmi.command.nick.bypassinuse
units.translation: 可通过 cmi.command.nick.bypassinuse 绕过名称或昵称已被占用的限制

units.source: Min length of nick name, can be bypassed with cmi.command.nick.bypass.length
units.translation: 昵称最小长度，可通过 cmi.command.nick.bypass.length 绕过

units.source: Max length of nick name, can be bypassed with cmi.command.nick.bypass.length
units.translation: 昵称最大长度，可通过 cmi.command.nick.bypass.length 绕过

units.source: When enabled players will not be able to choose existing real player names
units.translation: 启用后，不允许选择已存在的真实玩家名称

units.source: Can be bypassed with cmi.command.nick.bypassrealname permission node
units.translation: 可通过 cmi.command.nick.bypassrealname 权限绕过

units.source: Adds prefix for players nickname to indicate that its not real name. This can be added to display name with {nicknameprefix}
units.translation: 为昵称添加前缀，表明它不是真实名称。可通过 {nicknameprefix} 加入显示名称

units.source: When true, will only add nickname prefix when its not same as original name. This can allow colorization or capitalization change without adding prefix
units.translation: 设为 true，只有昵称与原名不同时才添加前缀，因此仅修改颜色或大小写时可不加前缀

units.source: When true, online players nick name will be used instead of real name in tabcomplete
units.translation: 设为 true，Tab 补全使用在线玩家的昵称，而不是真实名称

units.source: When true, we will include real name on top of nickname. This only has effect when ReplaceName is enabled
units.translation: 设为 true，在昵称上方同时显示真实名称；仅在 ReplaceName 启用时生效

units.source: When set to true colored lether armor will be bound to the player who receives that coloration and will not work on others if he would give it to them
units.translation: 设为 true，染色皮革盔甲的动态颜色绑定到获得该颜色的玩家，交给其他玩家后不再生效

units.source: Only applies for dynamic armor colors like biome, health and so on
units.translation: 仅影响生物群系、生命值等动态盔甲颜色

units.source: Shows if there is an available new version on login with cmi.versioncheck permission node
units.translation: 拥有 cmi.versioncheck 权限的玩家登录时，提示是否有新版本

units.source: If you experiencing issues with spawner handling, set this to true to avoid any spawner manipulations from CMI side
units.translation: 刷怪笼处理出现问题时，可设为 true，关闭 CMI 对刷怪笼的操作

units.source: This will disable features like, spawner placement, spawner drops, spawner charges and so on
units.translation: 这会关闭刷怪笼放置、掉落、挖掘次数等功能

units.source: ATTENTION! cmi.dropspawner will be required to get spawner dropping for the player
units.translation: 注意！玩家必须拥有 cmi.dropspawner 权限，破坏刷怪笼时才会掉落

units.source: Enable or disable spawner handler for spawner break
units.translation: 开启或关闭刷怪笼破坏处理

units.source: If enabled player will get spawner if using silktouch pickaxe and have cmi.dropspawner permission node
units.translation: 启用后，使用精准采集镐且拥有 cmi.dropspawner 权限时，破坏刷怪笼可获得掉落

units.source: If player has cmi.dropspawner.nosilk permission node, player is not required to use silk touch pickaxe to get droped spawner
units.translation: 拥有 cmi.dropspawner.nosilk 权限时，无需精准采集镐也能获得刷怪笼

units.source: When enabled item stack will receive custom name based on spawners type
units.translation: 启用后，刷怪笼物品按其生物类型设置自定义名称

units.source: When enabled instead of dropping spawner on the ground, player will received this item directly into their inventory
units.translation: 启用后，刷怪笼直接放入玩家物品栏，不掉落到地面

units.source: In case inventory is full then item will be dropped on the ground
units.translation: 物品栏已满时，仍会掉落到地面

units.source: If set to true, player will need to have particular permission node to break and get particular spawner.
units.translation: 设为 true，破坏并获得指定类型的刷怪笼需要对应权限

units.source: In example: player should have cmi.dropspawner.pig to break pig spawner and get it dropped, or cmi.dropspawner.zombie to get zombie spawner
units.translation: 例如破坏猪刷怪笼并获得掉落需要 cmi.dropspawner.pig，僵尸刷怪笼需要 cmi.dropspawner.zombie

units.source: When set to false, exp will not be dropped from broken spawner independent if spawner it self is being dropped
units.translation: 设为 false，破坏刷怪笼不掉经验，无论刷怪笼本身是否掉落

units.source: When set to true exp will be dropped only if spawner is not
units.translation: 设为 true，只在刷怪笼本身不掉落时掉经验

units.source: Minimal silktouch level required to get spawner back
units.translation: 获得刷怪笼所需的最低精准采集等级

units.source: Number in percentage from 0 up to 100 for a spawner to be dropped when you break one
units.translation: 破坏刷怪笼后的掉落概率，范围为 0 到 100，单位为百分比

units.source: Enable or disable spawner dropping stopping after certain amount of spawners being mined
units.translation: 是否在挖掘一定数量的刷怪笼后停止掉落

units.source: Number of spawners player is able to actually mine before its drop chance is set to 0
units.translation: 玩家最多可挖掘的刷怪笼数量，达到后掉落概率设为 0

units.source: This is based on players statistics records of mined spawners in total, this INCLUDES failed drops as well, so adjust acordingly
units.translation: 按玩家统计中的刷怪笼总挖掘数计算，也包含未成功掉落的次数，请据此调整

units.source: Permission as cmi.dropspawner.stopafter.[positivevalue] can be used to define limit with permission node instead
units.translation: 也可通过 cmi.dropspawner.stopafter.[positivevalue] 权限指定上限

units.source: When enabled drop change will slowly drop down based on previous set value and how many spawners player has mined
units.translation: 启用后，掉落概率按上述上限和已挖掘数量逐渐降低

units.source: This will not go lower than 1% of drop chance until previous set value is reached
units.translation: 达到上述上限之前，掉落概率不会低于 1%

units.source: Enable or disable spawner handler for spawner place
units.translation: 开启或关闭刷怪笼放置处理

units.source: If enabled player will place spawner depending from what it is by its type
units.translation: 启用后，按刷怪笼物品的生物类型放置

units.source: If disabled then spawner will be placed in normal way and it will allow other plugins to handle its placement
units.translation: 关闭后，按普通方式放置，交由其他插件处理

units.source: If set to true, player will need to have appropriate permission node to place spawner by its type
units.translation: 设为 true，按生物类型放置刷怪笼需要对应权限

units.source: RequiresPermission should be set to true for this to work. If set to true, player will need to have particular permission node to place particular spawner.
units.translation: 需要先将 RequiresPermission 设为 true。启用此项后，每种刷怪笼都需要单独的放置权限

units.source: In example: player should have cmi.placespawner.pig to place pig spawner, or cmi.placespawner.zombie to place zombie spawner
units.translation: 例如放置猪刷怪笼需要 cmi.placespawner.pig，僵尸刷怪笼需要 cmi.placespawner.zombie

units.source: If set to false, then player will need to have basic cmi.placespawner permission to place any type of spawner
units.translation: 设为 false，只需基础权限 cmi.placespawner 即可放置任意类型刷怪笼

units.source: When set to true, players trying to change spawner with monster egg will require appropriate permission node
units.translation: 设为 true，使用刷怪蛋修改刷怪笼需要对应权限

units.source: In example: player should have cmi.egginteract.pig to change spawner into pig, or cmi.egginteract.zombie to change into zombie spawner
units.translation: 例如改为猪需要 cmi.egginteract.pig，改为僵尸需要 cmi.egginteract.zombie

units.source: When set to true, players trying to change trial spawner with monster egg will require appropriate permission node
units.translation: 设为 true，使用刷怪蛋修改试炼刷怪笼需要对应权限

units.source: In example: player should have cmi.trialegginteract.pig to change spawner into pig, or cmi.trialegginteract.zombie to change into zombie spawner
units.translation: 例如改为猪需要 cmi.trialegginteract.pig，改为僵尸需要 cmi.trialegginteract.zombie

units.source: If set to true, spawners will have chance to be dropped when destroying with tnt
units.translation: 设为 true，TNT 炸毁刷怪笼时有概率掉落

units.source: Chance in percentage for spawner to drop
units.translation: 刷怪笼掉落概率，单位为百分比

units.source: If set to true, spawners will have chance to be dropped when destroyed by creeper
units.translation: 设为 true，苦力怕炸毁刷怪笼时有概率掉落

units.source: When enabled players will be assigned to particular spawner charges group who have cmi.spawners.charge.[groupName] permission node
units.translation: 启用后，根据 cmi.spawners.charge.[groupName] 权限将玩家分配到对应的刷怪笼挖掘次数组

units.source: Players will be limited to how many spawners they can mine
units.translation: 限制玩家能挖掘的刷怪笼数量

units.source: StartingCharge will determine how many charges they will have on first time joining group
units.translation: StartingCharge：首次加入该组时获得的挖掘次数

units.source: MaxCharge will limit to how many charges you can have at one time
units.translation: MaxCharge：可同时持有的挖掘次数上限

units.source: Cooldown determines how often new charge will be given
units.translation: Cooldown：恢复一次挖掘次数的间隔

units.source: Bonus is optional and it will determine by how many seconds to lower cooldown for next charge when placing spawner
units.translation: Bonus：可选项，放置刷怪笼时，将下一次次数恢复的冷却缩短多少秒

units.source: Option to bypass limitations with cmi.spawners.charge.bypass
units.translation: 可通过 cmi.spawners.charge.bypass 绕过限制

units.source: If set to true when player runs out of spawner charges spawner will be destroyed without droping it
units.translation: 设为 true，挖掘次数用尽后，破坏刷怪笼会将其摧毁而不掉落

units.source: Allows to limit how tight spawners can be placed from each other
units.translation: 限制刷怪笼之间的最小放置间距

units.source: Radius in blocks from placed block. Max range is 16
units.translation: 以放置位置为中心的半径，单位为方块，最大范围为 16

units.source: Can be bypassed with cmi.spawners.proximity.bypass
units.translation: 可通过 cmi.spawners.proximity.bypass 绕过

units.source: When set to true, players will be denyied from renaming defined items in anvil or with itemname command
units.translation: 设为 true，禁止通过铁砧或 itemname 命令为指定物品改名

units.source: Option to define specific name by using regex format
units.translation: 可使用正则表达式匹配指定名称

units.source: Can be bypassed with cmi.anvil.itemrename.bypass
units.translation: 可通过 cmi.anvil.itemrename.bypass 绕过

units.source: When set to true item renaming will be disabled in general, with anvil or command independent of renamed material
units.translation: 设为 true，全面禁止通过铁砧或命令改名，不论物品材质

units.source: This can be bypassed with previous permission node
units.translation: 可通过上面的权限绕过

units.source: Defines maximum length of item name excluding color codes for itemname command
units.translation: itemname 命令允许的物品名称最大长度，不含颜色代码

units.source: When enabled and items name is being colorized, we will enforce it to be in Italic to mimic vanilla item renaming
units.translation: 启用后，为物品名称添加颜色时强制使用斜体，模拟原版物品改名效果

units.source: When enabled we will check source item in adition to final one
units.translation: 启用后，除最终名称外，也检查原物品

units.source: This can prevent items with specific names being completely disabled from being renamed and prevent other items being renamed into them
units.translation: 可让特定名称的物品完全无法改名，同时防止其他物品改为这些名称

units.source: List of materials followed with optional regex code which can prevent specific naming, like renaming mob spawners into another type while still allowing renaming spawner into anything else
units.translation: 材质列表，可在材质后附正则表达式。例如禁止将某种刷怪笼改名为另一种，但仍允许改为其他名称

units.source: Use * for material name if you want to apply this filter to all items, for example *:([A-z])
units.translation: 用 * 表示全部材质，例如 *:([A-z])

units.source: Defines how many passengers entities can be spawned at once
units.translation: 一次最多可生成的乘客实体数量

units.source: Default range to use when performing /counter start
units.translation: /counter start 使用的默认范围

units.source: Defines how far in blocks from mirror center you can build
units.translation: 允许在距离镜像中心多远的位置建造，单位为方块

units.source: This is mainly to protect from forgeting to turn off mirror and starting to build on different side of map
units.translation: 主要防止忘记关闭镜像后，又在地图其他位置开始建造

units.source: Max amount of blocks to be modified in one go
units.translation: 单次最多修改的方块数

units.source: Keep this realitvely low to avoid unesecerry load on server due to each block requiring separte checks
units.translation: 每个方块都需要单独检查，请保持较低数值，避免额外负载

units.source: When disabled block will not be broken in mirror mode
units.translation: 关闭后，镜像模式不执行方块破坏

units.source: This is mainly to prevent this feature being used for mining purposes and not for building
units.translation: 主要避免此功能被用于挖矿，而不是建造

units.source: Can prevent nether portal creation entirely. Option to bypass with cmi.netherportalbypass
units.translation: 可完全阻止创建下界传送门，通过 cmi.netherportalbypass 绕过

units.source: Maximum height nether portal can be created. Vanilla size is 23
units.translation: 下界传送门的最大高度，原版为 23

units.source: Maximum width nether portal can be created. Vanilla size is 23
units.translation: 下界传送门的最大宽度，原版为 23

units.source: Defines in milliseconds how often to check if player entered portal or not
units.translation: 检查玩家是否进入传送区域的间隔，单位为毫秒

units.source: Bigger numbers can help slightly lower server load but small portals, 1 block depth without back wall can be passed through without teleportations if player moves fast enought
units.translation: 数值较大可略微降低负载，但玩家移动过快时，可能穿过只有 1 格深且无背墙的传送门而未被传送

units.source: Defines in milliseconds how often to check if player entered portal range for particles to apear
units.translation: 检查玩家是否进入传送门粒子显示范围的间隔，单位为毫秒

units.source: Should we perform commands without set destination location by default
units.translation: 默认是否允许没有目标位置的传送区域执行命令

units.source: This only effects newly created portal areas
units.translation: 仅影响新建的传送区域

units.source: When set to true at moment you create portal you can enter it and commands defined belove will be performed without teleporting you anywhere
units.translation: 设为 true，新建传送区域后，进入时会执行下方命令，而不会传送到其他位置

units.source: This can be change for each portal independently with ingame portal editor
units.translation: 可在游戏内传送门编辑器中，为每个传送区域单独修改

units.source: Commands to be performed on teleport event
units.translation: 发生传送时执行的命令

units.source: Enable sitting on stair block by clicking on them with empty hand or by looking and using command
units.translation: 允许空手点击楼梯，或看着楼梯使用命令坐下

units.source: Requires cmi.command.sit.stairs
units.translation: 需要 cmi.command.sit.stairs 权限

units.source: Player will sit on chair only after rapid double click
units.translation: 只有快速双击后，玩家才会坐下

units.source: Delay in milliseconds between clicks to sit on chair when double click is enabled
units.translation: 启用双击坐下时，两次点击的允许间隔，单位为毫秒

units.source: Range in blocks from player to look up for valid chair block
units.translation: 从玩家位置寻找有效椅子方块的范围，单位为方块

units.source: All possible damage causes: kill, world_border, entity_attack, entity_sweep_attack, projectile, suffocation, fall, fire, fire_tick, melting, lava, drowning, block_explosion, entity_explosion, void, lightning, suicide, starvation, poison, magic, wither, falling_block, thorns, dragon_breath, fly_into_wall, campfire, cramming, dryout, freeze, sonic_boom, custom
units.translation: 所有可用伤害原因：kill, world_border, entity_attack, entity_sweep_attack, projectile, suffocation, fall, fire, fire_tick, melting, lava, drowning, block_explosion, entity_explosion, void, lightning, suicide, starvation, poison, magic, wither, falling_block, thorns, dragon_breath, fly_into_wall, campfire, cramming, dryout, freeze, sonic_boom, custom

units.source: Syntax should be [permissionNode]:[damageCause]:[multiplier]
units.translation: 语法：[permissionNode]:[damageCause]:[multiplier]

units.source: Example: nolavadamage:lava:0 will prevent lava damage with cmi.damagecontrol.nolavadamage permission node
units.translation: 例如 nolavadamage:lava:0 会让拥有 cmi.damagecontrol.nolavadamage 权限的玩家免疫熔岩伤害

units.source: Negative values will heal player instead of damaging him
units.translation: 负数会恢复玩家生命值，而不是造成伤害

units.source: If player have more than one permission node for same damage cause, then last one in list will be used to determine final damage
units.translation: 同一伤害原因有多个匹配权限时，使用列表中最后一个计算最终伤害

units.source: When enabled some of the damage values can be adjusted
units.translation: 启用后，可调整部分伤害数值

units.source: When this set to true, on players death totem will be used even if he is not holding it in hand
units.translation: 设为 true，玩家死亡时即使未手持不死图腾，也会使用图腾

units.source: Require permission node for totem to be taken from inventory
units.translation: 从物品栏取用图腾是否需要权限

units.source: RemoveFromInventory should be set to true and if this enabled player will need cmi.totem.frominventory
units.translation: 需要先将 RemoveFromInventory 设为 true；启用此项后，玩家还需要 cmi.totem.frominventory 权限

units.source: When this set to true player can use totem only every X second's
units.translation: 设为 true，玩家每隔 X 秒才能使用一次不死图腾

units.source: When this set to true player can use totem to have X amount of second's, during which he can die and be resurected
units.translation: 设为 true，使用图腾后获得 X 秒保护时间，在此期间死亡可以复活

units.source: Totem will be consumed durring activation and wont be returned even if resurection is not used during warmup time
units.translation: 图腾在激活时消耗；即使在保护时间内未触发复活，也不会退还

units.source: If player falls into void while having totem, he will be teleported to respawn location and totem gets consumed
units.translation: 玩家携带图腾掉入虚空时，将其传送到重生位置并消耗图腾

units.source: Time in seconds effect needs to be applied to the player. Set it to 0 if you want to disable it
units.translation: 给玩家施加效果的持续时间，单位为秒；设为 0 关闭

units.source: Worlds where totem handling will be left for server default behavior
units.translation: 这些世界中的图腾交由服务端按默认行为处理

units.source: Worlds where totem usage is disabled entirely
units.translation: 完全禁用图腾的世界

units.source: cmi.elytra - allows usage of elytra
units.translation: cmi.elytra - 允许使用鞘翅

units.source: cmi.elytra.boost - allows usage of boost
units.translation: cmi.elytra.boost - 允许普通加速

units.source: cmi.elytra.superboost - allows ussage of super boost
units.translation: cmi.elytra.superboost - 允许超级加速

units.source: cmi.elytra.speedometer - allows to see speedometer
units.translation: cmi.elytra.speedometer - 允许查看速度表

units.source: Max speed until player wont get any boost
units.translation: 达到此速度后不再提供加速

units.source: When enabled items/exp wont be consumed if player is over speed limit
units.translation: 启用后，超出速度上限时不消耗物品或经验

units.source: Do you want to show decimals in speed
units.translation: 速度是否显示小数

units.source: By how much boost player on each use
units.translation: 每次普通加速增加的速度

units.source: By how much boost player on each super boost use
units.translation: 每次超级加速增加的速度

units.source: Use shift while using simple boost
units.translation: 使用普通加速时按住潜行键

units.source: Uses defined items instead of exp
units.translation: 消耗指定物品代替经验

units.source: Item material name
units.translation: 物品材质名称

units.source: Defines item which will be consumed for each boost event
units.translation: 每次加速时消耗的物品

units.source: Set it to AIR if you want to allow boost without holding any particular item in your hand
units.translation: 设为 AIR，允许不手持特定物品加速

units.source: Keep in mind that you still need to hold any item or click left mouse button for it to work when its set to AIR
units.translation: 设为 AIR 时，仍需手持任意物品，或点击鼠标左键才能生效

units.source: Set it to AIR if you want to allow launch to be performed without holding any particular item in your hand
units.translation: 设为 AIR，允许不手持特定物品起飞

units.source: Keep in mind that you still need to hold any item or look at a block for it to work properly when its set to AIR
units.translation: 设为 AIR 时，仍需手持任意物品，或看着方块才能正常生效

units.source: Requires to hold defined item in hand. Only when UseItems is set to false
units.translation: 需要手持指定物品，仅在 UseItems 为 false 时生效

units.source: Amount of exp consumed on each boost
units.translation: 每次普通加速消耗的经验点数

units.source: Amount of exp consumed on each super boost
units.translation: 每次超级加速消耗的经验点数

units.source: Shows particles when flying
units.translation: 飞行时显示粒子

units.source: 1.13+ servers. Do you want to disable riptide enchant usage while flying with elytra and trident which has riptide enchant
units.translation: 适用于 1.13+：是否禁止鞘翅飞行时使用三叉戟的激流附魔

units.source: This combination is dangerous as player can reach extreme speed's if allowed to use it
units.translation: 这种组合可能让玩家达到极高速度

units.source: Disables option to damage yourself while flying with arrows to boost up
units.translation: 禁止飞行时通过箭矢伤害自己来加速

units.source: Disables option to use rockets to boost yourself while flying with elytra
units.translation: 禁止使用烟花火箭为鞘翅加速

units.source: By default boss bar message will be shown with remaining charges. If disabled then bossbar will only appear when flight charge was modified but not when its depleating while flying
units.translation: 默认持续通过 Boss 栏显示剩余飞行能量。关闭后，只在能量发生修改时显示，不在飞行消耗期间显示

units.source: When set to true, each time player gets flight charge or relogs, his fly mode will be toggled on
units.translation: 设为 true，获得飞行能量或重新登录后，自动开启飞行模式

units.source: If set to false, then players will have to manually turn on flight with /cmi flyc
units.translation: 设为 false，玩家需要手动执行 /cmi flyc 开启飞行

units.source: When set to true, in event of player changing his game mode from survival/adventure to creative/spectator his flight charge  mode will get disabled
units.translation: 设为 true，从生存或冒险模式切换到创造或旁观模式时，关闭飞行能量模式

units.source: Same applies when changing game mode from creative/spectator to survival/adventure
units.translation: 从创造或旁观切换回生存或冒险时，也同样处理

units.source: How much it costs for one recharge point in exp points. Value can be in decimals, like 0.2 but it cant be equal or lower than 0
units.translation: 每点飞行能量消耗的经验点数。可填 0.2 等小数，但不能小于或等于 0

units.source: Set to 0 to disable this type of recharge
units.translation: 设为 0 关闭这种补充方式

units.source: How much it costs for one recharge point. Value can be in decimals, like 0.2 but it cant be equal or lower than 0
units.translation: 每点飞行能量的价格。可填 0.2 等小数，但不能小于或等于 0

units.source: Defines maximum amount of charge player can have
units.translation: 玩家飞行能量上限

units.source: One charge is one traveled block while flying
units.translation: 飞行时每移动一个方块消耗一点能量

units.source: if player doesn't move, then one charge for each second while hovering
units.translation: 悬停不动时，每秒消耗一点能量

units.source: Defines multiplier when player doesn't move but is hovering. For each second player hovers.
units.translation: 悬停不动时，每秒消耗能量的倍率

units.source: If this is set above 0, then player will loose defined amount of charges each second they are flying instead of traveled blocks
units.translation: 设为大于 0 的值后，按飞行秒数扣除指定能量，不再按移动距离计算

units.source: Set to 0 to disable, which will deduct charges for traveled blocks
units.translation: 设为 0 关闭固定秒耗，改按移动方块数扣除能量

units.source: Value in percentage when we should automatically recharge players flight charges if player enabled autorecharge with /autorecharge command
units.translation: 玩家通过 /autorecharge 开启自动补充后，剩余能量低于最大值的多少百分比时触发

units.source: Value in percentage of charges we need to recharge
units.translation: 每次自动补充的能量占上限的百分比

units.source: 25 will result into 25% of max allowed charges being recharged each time auto recharge is triggered
units.translation: 25 表示每次触发时补充最大能量的 25%

units.source: Defines multiplier when player falls down of charge to be taken
units.translation: 玩家下落时，额外扣除能量的倍率

units.source: This only effects when player falls from above 3 blocks of hight
units.translation: 仅影响超过 3 格高度的下落

units.source: In example if player falls from 10 blocks height, then 7 * 2 = 14 charges will be taken
units.translation: 例如从 10 格高度落下，扣除 7 * 2 = 14 点能量

units.source: This is to prevent avoiding no penalty from jumping from cliffs
units.translation: 用于防止通过跳下悬崖避开能量消耗

units.source: Defines if you want to damage player when he falls down from higher than 3 blocks height
units.translation: 从超过 3 格的高度下落时，是否对玩家造成伤害

units.source: This will not kill player even if he would drop from 200 block height, but will leave him with 1 hp
units.translation: 即使从 200 格高度落下也不会直接死亡，最低保留 1 点生命值

units.source: This will only effect players who jumped down and not those who disabled fly mode in mid air
units.translation: 仅影响主动跳下的玩家，不影响在半空中关闭飞行的玩家

units.source: DamageOnFall should be enabled for this to work
units.translation: 需要启用 DamageOnFall 才生效

units.source: This will define if you want to damage player when he deactivates fly mode in mid air
units.translation: 在半空中关闭飞行时，是否对玩家造成伤害

units.source: This will define if you want to kill player if fall damage if higher than his health amount
units.translation: 摔落伤害高于剩余生命值时，是否允许玩家死亡

units.source: When color name is defined then at moment player starts flying with flight charges, he will start glowing
units.translation: 填写颜色名称后，玩家开始使用飞行能量飞行时会发光

units.source: Set this to 'none' if you want to disable it

units.source: If set to true, login message wont be shown
units.translation: 设为 true，不显示加入消息

units.source: Defines number of players from which to automatically start hiding join messages
units.translation: 在线人数达到多少时，自动隐藏加入消息

units.source: Set to -1 to disable this
units.translation: 设为 -1 关闭

units.source: If set to true, custom login message will be used. cmi.messages.disablelogin can be used to disable message for player
units.translation: 设为 true，使用自定义加入消息；可通过 cmi.messages.disablelogin 关闭指定玩家的消息

units.source: When enabled and you have bungeeserver with CMIB on it we will try to detect where player went and we will show switch server message instead of login if possible
units.translation: 启用后，如果 BungeeCord 安装了 CMIB，会尝试判断玩家切服情况，并尽可能用切服消息代替加入消息

units.source: If set to true, logout message wont be shown
units.translation: 设为 true，不显示退出消息

units.source: Defines number of players from which to automatically start hiding logout messages
units.translation: 在线人数达到多少时，自动隐藏退出消息

units.source: If set to true, custom logout message will be used. cmi.messages.disablequit can be used to disable message for player
units.translation: 设为 true，使用自定义退出消息；可通过 cmi.messages.disablequit 关闭指定玩家的消息

units.source: When enabled and you have bungeeserver with CMIB on it we will try to detect where player went and we will show switch server message instead of logout if possible
units.translation: 启用后，如果 BungeeCord 安装了 CMIB，会尝试判断玩家切服情况，并尽可能用切服消息代替退出消息

units.source: Check locale file for translation and custom placeholders: [playername], [totalUsers], [onlinePlayers]
units.translation: 翻译及自定义占位符见语言文件：[playername]、[totalUsers]、[onlinePlayers]

units.source: When enabled player names will be checked against provided regex and if match is found then login and/or logout message will not be shown
units.translation: 启用后，用指定正则表达式检查玩家名称，匹配时不显示相应的加入或退出消息

units.source: Defines default creator name for books when using getbook command
units.translation: getbook 命令生成书籍时使用的默认作者名称

units.source: When set to true books write date will be added
units.translation: 设为 true，在书籍中添加编写日期

units.source: Defines name of customtext on players login to server. To disable just set name to non existing customText
units.translation: 玩家登录时显示的 customtext 名称；填入不存在的 customText 名称即可关闭

units.source: Should be always present. This will be used when category of warning isint being defined when warning player
units.translation: 应始终保留。警告玩家时未指定类别，就使用此项

units.source: Time in seconds for how long this warning applies to player
units.translation: 此警告对玩家的有效时长，单位为秒

units.source: Warning point amount player receives for warning
units.translation: 每次警告给予的警告点数

units.source: Default reason used when reason is not provided when warning player
units.translation: 警告时未提供原因，使用的默认原因

units.source: Forces players to login in defined spawn point when logging into server
units.translation: 玩家登录时，强制传送到指定出生点

units.source: Can be bypasses with cmi.spawnonjoin.bypass permission node
units.translation: 可通过 cmi.spawnonjoin.bypass 权限绕过

units.source: List of worlds which should be ignored and players joining in those servers will not be teleported to appropriate spawn point but will login at their log out location
units.translation: 忽略的世界列表。玩家在这些世界登录时，保留退出位置，不传送到对应出生点

units.source: Defines players spawn point after death if set to true, if not, then it will be used only for /cmi spawn command
units.translation: 设为 true，此位置也作为死亡重生点；否则只用于 /cmi spawn

units.source: RespawnLocation will indicate if you want to use this location as possible respawn point for player after death
units.translation: RespawnLocation 表示是否将此位置作为死亡后的可用重生点

units.source: TeleportFrom will indicate list of worlds from which player should be teleported to this spawn point
units.translation: TeleportFrom 指定从哪些世界登录的玩家会被传送到此出生点

units.source: Defines players first spawn point when he logs into server for the first time
units.translation: 玩家首次加入服务器时的出生位置

units.source: Kit name to give for new players joining server
units.translation: 给予新玩家的礼包名称

units.source: When set to true, kit list will be shown in GUI instead of chat list
units.translation: 设为 true，通过界面显示礼包列表，而不是聊天消息

units.source: When set to true, kit selection gui empty fields will get filled with default item (check CMILib)
units.translation: 设为 true，用默认物品填充礼包选择界面的空槽，见 CMILib

units.source: When enabled players can preview kits they have access to or have cmi.kit.[kitName].preview or cmi.kit.[kitName].* permission node
units.translation: 启用后，玩家可预览有权领取的礼包，或具有 cmi.kit.[kitName].preview、cmi.kit.[kitName].* 权限的礼包

units.source: Defines how {DATE} value will be formatted
units.translation: {DATE} 的显示格式

units.source: Icons for kit preview gui
units.translation: 礼包预览界面的图标

units.source: Setting icon to invalid item will hide button
units.translation: 将图标设为无效物品可隐藏按钮

units.source: Extra button to be used in case you want to provide any aditional information when clicking on it
units.translation: 额外按钮，可用于点击后显示补充信息

units.source: When set to true, warps list will be shown in GUI instead of chat list
units.translation: 设为 true，通过界面显示传送点列表，而不是聊天消息

units.source: Automatically opens GUI when created new warp point
units.translation: 创建新传送点后自动打开界面

units.source: Minimal length of warp name
units.translation: 传送点名称的最小长度

units.source: Maximal length of warp name
units.translation: 传送点名称的最大长度

units.source: How many warps to show in each page
units.translation: 每页显示的传送点数量

units.source: Do you want to show creator in warp list
units.translation: 是否在传送点列表中显示创建者

units.source: When set to true, new warps by default will require permission node to use them
units.translation: 设为 true，新建传送点默认需要权限才能使用

units.source: By setting to true will enable dynamic view range feature. Its still in beta stage and can result in some CPU load increase.
units.translation: 设为 true，启用动态视距。此功能仍为测试版，可能增加 CPU 负载

units.source: Don't enable if you are not using this feature on your server
units.translation: 服务器不使用此功能时，请不要开启

units.source: By setting to true fly and gamemode limitations per world will be aplied for player on world change if they don't have appropiate permission node
units.translation: 设为 true，切换世界时，对没有相应绕过权限的玩家应用该世界的飞行和游戏模式限制

units.source: World list with default game modes
units.translation: 各世界的默认游戏模式

units.source: If player will have cmi.worldlimit.gamemode.bypass permission node, game mode wont be changed
units.translation: 拥有 cmi.worldlimit.gamemode.bypass 权限时，不改变游戏模式

units.source: Possible modes: creative, survival, adventure, spectator,
units.translation: 可用模式：creative、survival、adventure、spectator

units.source: If player will have cmi.worldlimit.fly.bypass permission node, fly mode wont be changed
units.translation: 拥有 cmi.worldlimit.fly.bypass 权限时，不改变飞行状态

units.source: When enabled player will be able to fly after death if they were flying before death
units.translation: 启用后，玩家死亡前正在飞行，重生后仍可飞行

units.source: If player will have cmi.worldlimit.elytra.bypass permission node, elytra flight will not be prevented
units.translation: 拥有 cmi.worldlimit.elytra.bypass 权限时，不限制鞘翅飞行

units.source: Players joining worlds with disable elytra flight will get their elytra dismounted if possible
units.translation: 进入禁用鞘翅飞行的世界时，会尽可能卸下玩家的鞘翅

units.source: When set to false, only players with cmi.worldlimit.fly.aboveroof can fly above world build limit
units.translation: 设为 false，只有拥有 cmi.worldlimit.fly.aboveroof 权限的玩家才能飞到世界建造高度以上

units.source: If player will have cmi.worldlimit.god.bypass permission node, god mode wont be changed
units.translation: 拥有 cmi.worldlimit.god.bypass 权限时，不改变上帝模式

units.source: Checks if players name changed from last known
units.translation: 检查玩家名称是否与上次记录的不同

units.source: Do you want to perform commands
units.translation: 是否执行命令

units.source: Command list to be performed in case player logs in with new name
units.translation: 玩家使用新名称登录时执行的命令

units.source: Do you want to save the player's inventory on his death
units.translation: 是否在玩家死亡时保存物品栏

units.source: When set to true, empty inventories (no items in inventory) will not be saved on players death
units.translation: 设为 true，死亡时物品栏为空则不保存

units.source: If set to true then player should have cmi.saveinv permission node for inventory to be saved on death
units.translation: 设为 true，玩家必须拥有 cmi.saveinv 权限，死亡时才保存物品栏

units.source: How many inventories, we will keep for each player
units.translation: 每名玩家保留的物品栏记录数量

units.source: Set to false if you don't want to restore hp state on inventory load with /cmi invload command
units.translation: 设为 false，通过 /cmi invload 恢复物品栏时不恢复生命值

units.source: Set to false if you don't want to restore players experience points
units.translation: 设为 false，不恢复经验点数

units.source: Set to false if you don't want to restore food state
units.translation: 设为 false，不恢复饥饿值

units.source: Set to false if you don't want to restore saturation level
units.translation: 设为 false，不恢复饱和度

units.source: Set to false if you don't want to restore potion effects
units.translation: 设为 false，不恢复药水效果

units.source: Set to false if you don't want to restore items
units.translation: 设为 false，不恢复物品

units.source: List of materials we should not save
units.translation: 不保存的材质列表

units.source: Keep in mind that you might need to include all materials for colored items, like wool or shulker boxes
units.translation: 羊毛、潜影盒等有颜色变种的物品，可能需要列出每种颜色的材质

units.source: Do you want to give more than 20 hunger for players
units.translation: 是否允许玩家的饥饿值超过 20

units.source: Do you want to remove negative potion effects from player on heal
units.translation: 治疗玩家时，是否移除负面药水效果

units.source: When set to false will allow players to talk who is cuffed
units.translation: 设为 false，允许被铐住的玩家聊天

units.source: When set to true, player will not be allowed to send private messages while he is muted
units.translation: 设为 true，被禁言的玩家也无法发送私聊

units.source: Defines how big is dispose ui 1-6
units.translation: 垃圾桶界面的行数，范围为 1–6

units.source: Should we allow disposing items with attached commands in them
units.translation: 是否允许丢弃带附加指令的物品

units.source: Black list of materials we should not allow to dispose
units.translation: 禁止丢弃的材质黑名单

units.source: When neabling you will need to perform full server restart for it to take effect
units.translation: 开启后需要完整重启服务器才生效

units.source: When enabled will prevent players repairing items for others in anvil regular way. They still can use items and repairs normaly for them selfs
units.translation: 启用后，阻止玩家通过普通铁砧为其他人修复物品；本人修复后自己使用不受影响

units.source: Can be bypassed with cmi.command.repair.repairshare.bypass
units.translation: 可通过 cmi.command.repair.repairshare.bypass 绕过

units.source: When enabled will prevent players repairing items for others with CMI command. They still can use items and repairs normaly for them selfs
units.translation: 启用后，阻止玩家通过 CMI 命令为其他人修复物品；本人修复后自己使用不受影响

units.source: Sets durability on item when another picks it up or selects in inventory. Set to 0 or less if you don't want to change durability
units.translation: 其他玩家拾取或在物品栏中选中物品时，将耐久度设为此值。设为 0 或更小的值不修改耐久度

units.source: Attention! Keep this number above 0, otherwise item will get removed without option for the player to repair it throw some means, unless this is what you actually want
units.translation: 注意！应保持大于 0，否则物品会直接消失，玩家无法再通过其他方式修复，除非这正是预期行为

units.source: When set to true, player who have cmi.command.repair permission will bypass this protection and can use other user repaired items without any additional actions
units.translation: 设为 true，拥有 cmi.command.repair 权限的玩家可绕过保护，直接使用由其他玩家修复的物品

units.source: When enabled additional lore line will be added when player can't use that item. This will not be shown for owner of item
units.translation: 启用后，玩家不能使用该物品时会追加一行描述；物品所有者不会看到这行提示

units.source: When set to true, interact event will be canceled to prevent item usage
units.translation: 设为 true，取消交互事件，阻止使用物品

units.source: When set to true, player will get message informing about item usage he dint repaired him self
units.translation: 设为 true，提示玩家该物品并非由自己修复

units.source: List of custom model data id's we should not allow to be repaired with /repair command
units.translation: 禁止通过 /repair 修复的自定义模型数据 ID 列表

units.source: When item costs money, player will be required to confirm repair action by clicking message in chat
units.translation: 修复需要付费时，玩家必须点击聊天消息确认

units.source: When set to true, item repair with /cmi repair will cost money depending on setup
units.translation: 设为 true，/cmi repair 按以下设置收取费用

units.source: Player who performs command will pay repair cost
units.translation: 执行命令的玩家支付费用

units.source: If command gets performed from console, then player whose items are repaired will be paying
units.translation: 从控制台执行时，由被修复物品所属的玩家支付费用

units.source: Base price to repair item
units.translation: 物品的基础修复价格

units.source: If you have enabled durability check, then this value will wary depending on items condition
units.translation: 启用耐久度检查后，此费用会根据物品损坏程度变化

units.source: Item repair cost will depend on how baddly item is damaged
units.translation: 根据物品损坏程度计算修复费用

units.source: Adds extra cost to repair depending on items cost set in /cmi setworth
units.translation: 根据 /cmi setworth 设置的物品价格追加费用

units.source: Value should be set from 0 to 100 range
units.translation: 取值范围为 0 到 100

units.source: Adds extra cost to repair depending on items enchantment cost set in /cmi setenchantworth
units.translation: 根据 /cmi setenchantworth 设置的附魔价格追加费用

units.source: If item has more then one enchantment, then prices will be added up
units.translation: 有多个附魔时，将各项费用相加

units.source: You can enable any command cooldown to prevent instant usage of it
units.translation: 可以为任意命令设置冷却，防止连续立即使用

units.source: cmi heal:180 means that player can use /cmi heal command only once every 180 seconds
units.translation: cmi heal:180 表示每 180 秒只能执行一次 /cmi heal

units.source: if cooldown set to -1 then this command can be performed only one time
units.translation: 冷却设为 -1 时，该命令只能执行一次

units.source: Administration can bypass limitations with cmi.cooldownbypass.[commandname] permission node
units.translation: 管理员可通过 cmi.cooldownbypass.[commandname] 绕过

units.source: Always use full command name and not its alias
units.translation: 始终使用完整命令名称，不要使用别名

units.source: Alternatively you can use cmi.cooldown.[some_command].[timer] permission node. For example: cmi.cooldown.cmi_heal.30 which will set 30 second cooldown on /cmi heal command
units.translation: 也可使用 cmi.cooldown.[some_command].[timer] 权限，例如 cmi.cooldown.cmi_heal.30 为 /cmi heal 设置 30 秒冷却

units.source: If you want to apply cooldown on command when variable is provided, add extra _ at end. For example cmi.cooldown.cmi_heal_.30 which will only use this cooldown when healing some one else
units.translation: 要在带参数时才应用冷却，在命令末尾加 _。例如 cmi.cooldown.cmi_heal_.30 只限制治疗其他玩家的用法

units.source: KEEP IN MIND that for permission to work you need to set base command cooldown in this list, otherwise permission node will have no effect
units.translation: 注意！必须先在列表中设置基础命令冷却，权限才会生效

units.source: ATTENTION! If you have command like "/cmi home" and you want to prevent teleportation to home but allow gui opening without restrictions, use space after command, in example "cmi home :10"
units.translation: 注意！若要限制 /cmi home 传送，但不限制打开界面，在命令后保留空格，例如 "cmi home :10"

units.source: When set to true, players will not have option to open shulker boxes while in combat
units.translation: 设为 true，战斗期间不允许打开潜影盒

units.source: Combat timer can be defined under combat section
units.translation: 战斗判定时间可在 combat 部分设置

units.source: When set to true player will be required to have cmi.openshulker.edit permission to edit shulker box from inventory
units.translation: 设为 true，从物品栏编辑潜影盒内容需要 cmi.openshulker.edit 权限

units.source: Prevents players from being  pooled around while player is in afk mode
units.translation: 防止 AFK 玩家被拉走

units.source: EXPERIMENTAL! Prevents players from being pushed around while player is in afk mode
units.translation: 实验性功能！防止 AFK 玩家被推动

units.source: Keep in mind that player can still be moved around the same block he is in
units.translation: 玩家仍可能在当前所在的同一个方块内移动

units.source: Disables afk on inventory click
units.translation: 点击物品栏时退出 AFK

units.source: Disables afk on item drop
units.translation: 丢弃物品时退出 AFK

units.source: Disables afk on command usage
units.translation: 执行命令时退出 AFK

units.source: Disables afk on public chat message
units.translation: 发送公共聊天消息时退出 AFK

units.source: Disables afk on private chat message
units.translation: 发送私聊消息时退出 AFK

units.source: Disables afk on move
units.translation: 移动时退出 AFK

units.source: Disables afk on camera movement
units.translation: 转动视角时退出 AFK

units.source: Disables afk on fishing when you catch fish
units.translation: 钓到鱼时退出 AFK

units.source: Disables item pickup while afk
units.translation: AFK 时禁止拾取物品

units.source: When enabled we can prevent mob spawning near players who are afk
units.translation: 启用后，可阻止在 AFK 玩家附近生成生物

units.source: Prevents natural mob spawning
units.translation: 阻止自然生成生物

units.source: This can be more on heavy side of the server as it will try constantly to spawn in monsters near afk players
units.translation: 可能增加服务器负载，因为服务端仍会持续尝试在 AFK 玩家附近生成怪物

units.source: Prevent mob spawning from spawners
units.translation: 阻止刷怪笼生成生物

units.source: Usually responsible for spawning in iron golems
units.translation: 通常影响铁傀儡生成

units.source: Disables exp pickup while afk
units.translation: AFK 时禁止拾取经验

units.source: Attention! Because of weird minecraft handling of exp orbs, best way is to set orb to 0exp and allow it to be obsorbed
units.translation: 注意！由于 Minecraft 经验球的处理方式，较合适的做法是将经验球设为 0 经验后允许吸收

units.source: So by enabling this exp obsorbed by afk players will have no effect
units.translation: 因此启用后，AFK 玩家吸收经验球不会获得经验

units.source: Disables shulker targeting at the player who is in afk mode
units.translation: 禁止潜影贝将 AFK 玩家选为目标

units.source: All aliases to used with this plugin. In example original command for going back to spawn is /cmi spawn
units.translation: 此插件使用的命令别名。例如返回出生点的原命令为 /cmi spawn

units.source: By enabling appropriate alias you can use /spawn to get back to set spawn point
units.translation: 启用相应别名后，可用 /spawn 返回已设置的出生点

units.source: if it interferes with another plugin, just disable it here and reload plugin with /cmi reload
units.translation: 若与其他插件冲突，在此关闭对应别名，再执行 /cmi reload

units.source: Comment shows command to be performed by using alias defined one line belove it
units.translation: 注释显示使用下一行别名时实际执行的命令

units.source: True/false defines if alias is enabled or disabled
units.translation: True/false 表示启用或关闭别名

units.source: ATENTION! If you want to have custom alias and not only presets, use ingame command /cmi aliaseditor for this
units.translation: 注意！若要创建预设以外的自定义别名，请在游戏内使用 /cmi aliaseditor

units.source: This file will not accept new custom alias, for that we do have separate file
units.translation: 此文件不接受新增自定义别名；自定义别名使用另一个独立文件

units.source: When enabled automatic database backup will be done if existing file is older than specified interval

units.translation: 保留的自动备份文件数量

units.translation: 自动备份文件使用特定命名格式，例如 2025-09-04_13-20-42_cmi.sqlite.db

units.translation: 是否将数据库文件压缩为 ZIP，以减少体积
