units.translation: 可用值：usertable inventories playtime playtimereward

units.source: UserTable is always saved to be used for player ID refference when extracting data from backup
units.translation: 始终保存 UserTable，便于从备份提取数据时查找玩家 ID

units.source: Inteval in hours between backups
units.translation: 备份间隔，单位为小时

units.source: Keep in mind that backuping happens shortly after server startup and gets checked once every hour on regular basis
units.translation: 服务器启动后不久会执行备份检查，之后每小时检查一次

units.source: Tables you want to save when manually initiating backup
units.translation: 手动发起备份时保存的数据表

units.source: When enabled newer system for chat handling will be utilized
units.translation: 启用后，使用新版聊天处理系统

units.source: Recommended to keep this enabed if you have compatible server
units.translation: 服务端兼容时，建议保持开启

units.source: This only applies to Paper 1.17+ servers
units.translation: 仅适用于 Paper 1.17+ 服务器

units.source: Full server restart is needed while switching between different use types
units.translation: 切换聊天处理方式后，需要完整重启服务器

units.source: Will try to modify chat to display it in defined format
units.translation: 尝试将聊天消息修改为指定格式

units.source: If this is disabled and you have 3rd party plugin handling chat messages, consider disabling ClickHoverMessages section too if you notice any problems with chat formatting
units.translation: 关闭此项并由第三方插件处理聊天时，如果格式出现问题，也可以关闭 ClickHoverMessages

units.source: When set to true, regular and private messages (excludes clean messages) will have additional information when hovering over it (PlaceHolderAPI supported) and can be clicked for quick reply option
units.translation: 设为 true，普通和私聊消息附带悬停信息，并支持点击快速回复；纯净消息除外，支持 PlaceholderAPI

units.source: To change default hover over messages seen on sent message, go to your locale file to Chat section
units.translation: 要修改已发送消息的默认悬停文字，请编辑语言文件中的 Chat 部分

units.source: Has no effect if UsePaperType is enabled
units.translation: UsePaperType 启用时不生效

units.source: Enables support for DiscordSRV plugin
units.translation: 启用 DiscordSRV 插件支持

units.source: Defines name of global chat channel in discordsrv
units.translation: DiscordSRV 中全局聊天频道的名称

units.source: Indicator which can be used as {discord} in chat format to indicate that message came from discord and not ingame
units.translation: 可在聊天格式中使用 {discord}，标记消息来自 Discord 而非游戏内

units.source: When enabled and you have ranged messages enabled, we will send all of them to DiscordSRV
units.translation: 启用且设置了聊天范围时，将所有范围聊天消息都发送给 DiscordSRV

units.source: When disabled, only shouts and messages sent by players with cmi.chat.rangebypass permission node will be visible in discord
units.translation: 关闭后，Discord 只显示喊话，以及拥有 cmi.chat.rangebypass 权限的玩家发送的消息

units.source: Enables support for DynMap web chat
units.translation: 启用 DynMap 网页聊天支持

units.source: When set to false, each time you will use /r you will reply to person you previously sent message directly or to person who sent you message if there is none you have conversion before
units.translation: 设为 false，/r 回复最近主动私聊的对象；若之前没有主动交谈的对象，则回复最近给你发消息的人

units.source: When this set to true, players with /r will reply to person who last sent private message. This can result in confusion when using /r while getting private messages from multiple players
units.translation: 设为 true，/r 始终回复最后发来私聊的人；同时收到多人消息时，可能造成混淆

units.source: If ReplyToLastMessenger is set to false, then timeOut will be taken into consideration to who you should reply
units.translation: ReplyToLastMessenger 为 false 时，根据 timeOut 判断回复对象

units.source: If you had conversation in last 120 seconds (default) then even receiving message from 3rd person, you will still reply to original player
units.translation: 最近 120 秒内有过交谈时，即使第三个人发来私聊，仍回复原来的玩家，120 秒为默认值

units.source: If you had conversation in longer then 120 seconds period, then you will reply to latest person who send you a message
units.translation: 距离上次交谈超过 120 秒后，回复最近发来私聊的人

units.source: When set to true players will need to have cmi.command.msg.[groupname].send where [groupName] is receivers main permission group
units.translation: 设为 true，发送者需要 cmi.command.msg.[groupname].send 权限，其中 [groupName] 为接收者的主权限组

units.source: When set to false, web pge links in a chat will not get shortened to default [LINK] format
units.translation: 设为 false，聊天中的网址不缩写为默认的 [LINK] 格式

units.source: Defines regex when replacing url in chat with short word
units.translation: 识别聊天网址并替换为短文本的正则表达式

units.source: Examples:
units.translation: 示例：

units.source: When set to true, particular variables in chat will be translated into items player are holding. List of variables belove
units.translation: 设为 true，将聊天中的指定标记替换为玩家手持物品，标记列表见下方

units.source: When enabled item into chat will be replaced with an icon of that item, this only applies to items and not blocks, as not all blocks have associates sprites we could reliably utilize
units.translation: 启用后，用物品图标替代聊天中的物品标记。仅适用于物品，不适用于方块，因为部分方块没有可稳定使用的图标

units.source: Defines regex when replacing item line in chat with players item in hand information. Only works when CMI hover over chat format is enabled
units.translation: 识别聊天物品标记的正则表达式；仅在 CMI 聊天悬停格式启用时有效

units.source: Use (\[item(?::(\w+))?\]) if you want to allow [item:helmet] or [item:5], when defining this type of regex, second group needs to contain custom value
units.translation: 若要支持 [item:helmet] 或 [item:5]，使用 (\[item(?::(\w+))?\])；此类正则的第二个分组必须包含自定义值

units.source: Potential custom values are [item:mainhand] [item:offhand] [item:helmet] [item:chestplate] [item:pants] [item:boots] and [item:0-40] where number value is between 0 and 40 indicating inventory slot
units.translation: 可用值包括 [item:mainhand] [item:offhand] [item:helmet] [item:chestplate] [item:pants] [item:boots] 和 [item:0-40]，数字 0 到 40 表示物品栏槽位

units.source: Use (\[item\]) for simple [item] detection
units.translation: 仅识别 [item] 时，使用 (\[item\])

units.source: Attention! This will require you to have CMI Bungee plugin which can be found at zrips.net
units.translation: 注意！需要安装 CMI Bungee 插件，可在 zrips.net 找到

units.source: Or direct download https://www.zrips.net/cmi/
units.translation: 或从 https://www.zrips.net/cmi/ 下载

units.source: Do you want to enable private messaging over bungeecord
units.translation: 是否启用 BungeeCord 跨服私聊

units.source: Bungee cord support needs to be enabled for this to have any effect
units.translation: 需要先启用 BungeeCord 支持才生效

units.source: Do you want to enable public messaging over bungeecord
units.translation: 是否启用 BungeeCord 跨服公共聊天

units.source: Player needs to have cmi.bungee.publicmessages.[servername] permission node to be able to send messages to target server
units.translation: 向指定服务器发消息需要 cmi.bungee.publicmessages.[servername] 权限

units.source: When enabled public messages addressed to single player will be ignored and not sent across networkd
units.translation: 启用后，只发给单个玩家的公共消息不会转发到整个群组服

units.source: This only applies when we have more than one player online and chat range is set to be global
units.translation: 仅在在线人数超过一人，且聊天范围为全局时生效

units.source: Do you want to enable staff messaging over bungeecord
units.translation: 是否启用 BungeeCord 跨服管理聊天

units.source: Used for simple chat messages. Optional variables: {displayName} {world} {prefix} {suffix} {group} {shout} {shoutcolor} {message} {nicknameprefix}. Supporting PlaceHolderAPI variables like %player_server% %cmi_user_chatcolor%
units.translation: 普通聊天格式。可用变量：{displayName} {world} {prefix} {suffix} {group} {shout} {shoutcolor} {message} {nicknameprefix}。支持 %player_server% %cmi_user_chatcolor% 等 PlaceholderAPI 变量

units.source: As of 1.21.9 Paper servers you can include {head} to add players head icon
units.translation: 从 1.21.9 Paper 起，可使用 {head} 加入玩家头像

units.source: ATTENTION! Don't use gradient colors for {message} variable, if you want to apply gradient for it, utilize GeneralMessageFormat section
units.translation: 注意！不要直接给此处的 {message} 使用渐变色；请通过 GeneralMessageFormat 设置

units.source: Will define message format itself, this allows to have gradients in messages
units.translation: 消息正文的格式，允许在消息中使用渐变色

units.source: It NEEDS to contain {message} otherwise we will ignore this setup
units.translation: 必须包含 {message}，否则忽略此设置

units.source: For 1.16+ servers you can use color gradients like '{#b3a28f>}{message}{#d7b8e6<}'
units.translation: 1.16+ 可使用渐变色，例如 '{#b3a28f>}{message}{#d7b8e6<}'

units.source: You can have more than 2 colors in gradient. To define it repeat {message} variable. For example '{#b3a28f>}{message}{#5c6999<>}{message}{#d7b8e6<}'
units.translation: 渐变可超过 2 种颜色，只需重复 {message}，例如 '{#b3a28f>}{message}{#5c6999<>}{message}{#d7b8e6<}'

units.source: Use %cmi_user_chatcolor% to add players choosen chat color
units.translation: 使用 %cmi_user_chatcolor% 添加玩家选择的聊天颜色

units.source: Defines range of regular messages to travel
units.translation: 普通聊天的传播范围

units.source: Set to -1 to disable range restriction
units.translation: 设为 -1 取消范围限制

units.source: Defines range of shout messages to travel
units.translation: 喊话的传播范围

units.source: Shout messages should start with ! and player should have cmi.chat.shout permission
units.translation: 喊话以 ! 开头，玩家需要 cmi.chat.shout 权限

units.source: GeneralRange should be enabled
units.translation: 需要启用 GeneralRange

units.source: set to 0 to shout across all worlds, -1 to disable
units.translation: 设为 0，喊话覆盖全部世界；设为 -1，关闭喊话

units.source: Color code to be used as base for the shout chat message
units.translation: 喊话消息的基础颜色代码

units.source: Defines cost for each shout message
units.translation: 每条喊话的费用

units.source: List of message range limits
units.translation: 消息范围限制列表

units.source: Player count fallowed by range
units.translation: 玩家数量，后接范围

units.source: Player amount defines from how many we should use this range
units.translation: 在线人数达到该数量时，使用对应范围

units.source: Prefix used to indicate that message should be sent to public chat instead of current players chat room
units.translation: 将消息发到公共聊天，而不是当前聊天室的前缀

units.source: Set it to empty field if you want this feature to be disabled
units.translation: 设为空文本即可关闭此功能

units.source: Time in seconds you want to keep chat rooms alive before removing them
units.translation: 空聊天室保留多久后移除，单位为秒

units.source: This only applies to empty rooms after last user leaves it
units.translation: 只影响最后一名玩家离开后的空聊天室

units.source: Defines suggested commands when you click on public, private and similar messages. [playerName], [playerDisplayName] and [playerNickName]  can be used to include players name
units.translation: 点击公共、私聊等消息时填入的建议命令。可用 [playerName]、[playerDisplayName]、[playerNickName] 插入玩家名称

units.source: Defines command (one command per type) to be performed by player when clicked on players name
units.translation: 点击玩家名称时，由玩家执行的命令，每种类型一条

units.source: When this is defined then ClickSuggestions will be changed to shift+left click action for suggested command
units.translation: 设置此项后，ClickSuggestions 的建议命令改为 Shift+左键触发

units.source: Command is performed as player, if you want to perform it from console then add asConsole! variable at the start of it
units.translation: 默认以玩家身份执行；要从控制台执行，在开头添加 asConsole!

units.source: Use numeric increments to separate groups from each other. If player has more than one, then line with higher number will be used
units.translation: 使用递增数字区分各组；有多个匹配权限时，使用数字较大的一行

units.source: Add as many lines as you need too
units.translation: 可按需要添加任意行

units.translation: 使用权限为 cmi.chatgroup.[id]

units.translation: 权限示例：cmi.chatgroup.2

units.translation: 注意！不要直接给此处的 {message} 使用渐变色；请通过 GroupMessageFormat 设置

units.translation: 使用权限为 cmi.chatmessagegroup.[id]

units.translation: 权限示例：cmi.chatmessagegroup.2

units.translation: 设为 true，过滤公共聊天中的颜色代码，玩家仅能使用权限允许的颜色

units.translation: cmi.colors.publicmessage.[colorName]

units.source: If set to true then /me messages will be filtered from color codes and will allow to colorize them with appropriate permission node
units.translation: 设为 true，过滤 /me 消息中的颜色代码，玩家仅能使用权限允许的颜色

units.translation: cmi.colors.me.[colorName]

units.translation: 设为 true，直接移除玩家无权使用的颜色代码，而不是保留在文字中

units.translation: 检查玩家无权使用的颜色代码时，忽略的字符串列表

units.translation: 这些内容绕过颜色代码限制，可用于允许特定聊天格式

units.translation: 仅影响公共聊天和私聊

units.translation: 设为 true，玩家修改昵称时过滤颜色代码

units.translation: cmi.colors.nickname.[colorName]

units.source: If set to true, players public message who is in your ignore list will not be shown
units.translation: 设为 true，不显示忽略列表中玩家的公共聊天

units.source: Enable or not tag system. This will inform player with his name mentioning in public chat if name have @ in front of it
units.translation: 是否启用提及系统。公共聊天中在名称前加 @，会提醒被提及的玩家

units.source: When this is set to true, any player mentionings in public messages will be colorized and player will get informed as usual
units.translation: 设为 true，公共聊天中出现玩家名称时都会着色并提醒对方

units.source: This is allot more heavier on server than usual tagging with @, so enable if you know what you are doing
units.translation: 比普通 @ 提及更消耗性能，请按需开启

units.source: Determines color of taged user name in chat with @ in front of name/nickname. Sender should have cmi.tag.color
units.translation: @ 名称或昵称的颜色，发送者需要 cmi.tag.color 权限

units.source: Commands to be performed when player is tagged
units.translation: 玩家被提及时执行的命令

units.source: Variables like [playerName] will be replaced with tagged player name
units.translation: [playerName] 等变量会替换为被提及的玩家名称

units.source: You can use [senderName] to include player name who tagged
units.translation: 可使用 [senderName] 插入发起提及的玩家名称

units.source: Will performd tag commands only when player is afk
units.translation: 只在被提及玩家处于 AFK 状态时执行命令

units.source: When set to true, @ simbol will be removed
units.translation: 设为 true，移除 @ 符号

units.source: Do you want to enable chat bubbles for public messages
units.translation: 是否为公共聊天启用聊天气泡

units.source: Each player can disable this with /options command personally
units.translation: 每名玩家可通过 /options 单独关闭

units.source: How high we should show chat bubble
units.translation: 聊天气泡的显示高度

units.source: Base time in seconds for chat bubble to be visible
units.translation: 聊天气泡的基础显示时间，单位为秒

units.source: Maximum time bubble will be shown for
units.translation: 气泡最长显示时间

units.source: Extra seconds to be added for each letter in a message
units.translation: 消息中每个字符额外增加的显示秒数

units.source: This will allow to have shorter times for short messages and increase it for longer ones
units.translation: 让短消息较快消失，长消息显示更久

units.source: Scale of chat bubble, default 1
units.translation: 聊天气泡缩放比例，默认为 1

units.source: Line width before wraping text to new line
units.translation: 超过此宽度后自动换行

units.source: Default Color code, this could be overriden if text itself was colorized
units.translation: 默认颜色代码；文字本身有颜色时可覆盖此值

units.source: Leave it empty for default transparent color
units.translation: 留空使用默认透明颜色

units.source: Example of color code: {#black}
units.translation: 颜色代码示例：{#black}

units.source: Value between 0 and 1 where 0 means no background color and 1 is fully opaque
units.translation: 取值为 0 到 1，0 为无背景色，1 为完全不透明

units.source: Do you want to add text shadow
units.translation: 是否添加文字阴影

units.source: Higher group will be prioritized if player has access to more than one permission node
units.translation: 玩家有多个匹配权限时，优先使用数值较高的组

units.source: Colors are defined in hex format with optional alpha channel in RGBA format
units.translation: 颜色使用十六进制格式，可选带透明通道的 RGBA 格式

units.source: If not set to true, this filter will not be used
units.translation: 未设为 true 时，不使用此过滤规则

units.source: Defines filter group and defines required permission node to bypass this filter: cmi.chatfilter.bypass.[groupName]
units.translation: 过滤组名称，同时决定绕过此规则的权限：cmi.chatfilter.bypass.[groupName]

units.source: When set to true, each time player triggers filter, console will receive information about who triggered it, which filter and with what message
units.translation: 设为 true，每次触发时，在控制台记录玩家、规则及原消息

units.source: Regex expression to filter by. How to use regex https://regexone.com/
units.translation: 用于过滤的正则表达式。正则用法见 https://regexone.com/

units.source: With what we need to replace word, if not defined found expression will not be changed
units.translation: 替换成的文字；未设置时，不修改匹配内容

units.source: possible: none, others, all
units.translation: 可用值：none、others、all

units.source: Where 'none' means everyone will receive this message
units.translation: 'none'：所有人都能收到消息

units.source: 'others' means that sender will get message but not other players, this is usefull to prevent advertising and silently block it
units.translation: 'others'：只有发送者能看到消息，其他人看不到，适合静默拦截广告

units.source: 'all' means that no one will receive sent message
units.translation: 'all'：所有人都收不到消息

units.source: When enabled rule will be applied to private messages
units.translation: 启用后，此规则也应用于私聊

units.source: Players with cmi.chatfilter.inform permission will receive defined message when rule is broken
units.translation: 触发规则时，拥有 cmi.chatfilter.inform 权限的玩家会收到指定提示

units.source: List of commands to perform when rule is broken. Use [senderName] to include message sender name. Supports global variables same as locale file
units.translation: 触发规则时执行的命令。可用 [senderName] 插入发送者名称，也支持与语言文件相同的全局变量

units.source: Use [message] to include original players message
units.translation: 使用 [message] 插入玩家原始消息

units.source: Use [updatedmessage] to include new modified message
units.translation: 使用 [updatedmessage] 插入修改后的消息

units.source: List of regex filter to exlude from block list. Usefull if you want to block all ip/host address but want to allow usage of your own server.
units.translation: 从拦截规则中排除的正则列表，例如拦截全部 IP 或域名，但允许自己的服务器地址

units.source: When set to true, plugin will prevent spaming of same or similar messages in short time range. Can be bypased with cmi.chatfilter.spambypass permission
units.translation: 设为 true，阻止短时间内重复发送相同或相似消息。可通过 cmi.chatfilter.spambypass 绕过

units.source: How much in percentage message is counted as same
units.translation: 判定为相同消息的相似度百分比

units.source: Defines how often in seconds you can send same/similar message
units.translation: 重复发送相同或相似消息的最小间隔，单位为秒

units.source: When nebaled we will try to prevent chat messages with multiple capitalized letters by defined criteria
units.translation: 启用后，按以下规则限制大量使用大写字母的消息

units.source: Can be bypassed with cmi.chatfilter.capbypass permission node
units.translation: 可通过 cmi.chatfilter.capbypass 绕过

units.source: Defines amount of letters we can ignore
units.translation: 可忽略的字符数量

units.source: For example ':DDD' would be made of 2 letters with 3 capitalized letters which would make it 75% capitalized
units.translation: 例如 ':DDD' 由 2 个字母组成，其中有 3 个大写字母，因此大写占比为 75%

units.source: Amount in percentage of capitalized letters we should not cross over.
units.translation: 允许的大写字母百分比上限

units.source: In example 'GOOD thing' would be 4 capitalized and 5 not, spaces gets ignored, which makes it 44% capitalized and passes check
units.translation: 例如 'GOOD thing' 有 4 个大写和 5 个非大写字母，忽略空格后，大写比例为 44%，可通过检查

units.source: When capitalized text is detected, should we lower case text
units.translation: 检测到过多大写字母时，是否转为小写

units.source: Should we cancel chat event if we detect too many caps
units.translation: 检测到过多大写字母时，是否取消聊天事件

units.source: List of commands you want to perform when player uses too many caps
units.translation: 玩家使用过多大写字母时执行的命令

units.source: List of messages, excluding color codes, player can use even if it 100% capitalized
units.translation: 即使全部大写也允许的消息列表，不含颜色代码

units.source: Enables simpler replacer feature for public and private messages
units.translation: 为公共聊天和私聊启用简易替换

units.source: Quick replacer for inputs like :heart: into ❤
units.translation: 快速将 :heart: 等输入替换为 ❤

units.source: Emojies to be used for emojipicker command
units.translation: emojipicker 命令可使用的表情

units.source: Defines combat timer to be used in particular features
units.translation: 各项功能使用的战斗判定时长

units.source: When enabled we will allow for players to be damaged in safe zone if they are tagged for pvp
units.translation: 启用后，已被标记为 PvP 状态的玩家，即使进入安全区也可受伤

units.source: If set to true, then player who gets placed into combat mode will get its fly mode disabled
units.translation: 设为 true，玩家进入战斗状态时关闭飞行

units.source: This will disable players fly mode which will result in player dropping down and will disable option to start flying
units.translation: 会让玩家掉落，并阻止重新开启飞行

units.source: This can be bypassed by player performing fly command if he has access to it and commands durring combat are not blocked
units.translation: 若战斗中未禁用命令，且玩家有权执行 fly，仍可手动开启飞行

units.source: Can be bypassed with cmi.pvp.PFlyBypass permission node
units.translation: 可通过 cmi.pvp.PFlyBypass 绕过

units.source: If set to true, then attacked player will be included into combat mode even if he doesnt fight back
units.translation: 设为 true，被攻击的玩家即使不还手，也会进入战斗状态

units.source: If set to false then only attacker will be marked for pvp mode
units.translation: 设为 false，只将攻击者标记为 PvP 状态

units.source: If set to true player whose fly mode got disabled will not suffer fall damage, once
units.translation: 设为 true，因关闭飞行而落下的玩家获得一次摔落伤害豁免

units.source: When set to true player will see boss bar message indicating how long until combat mode ends
units.translation: 设为 true，通过 Boss 栏显示距离战斗状态结束的时间

units.source: This only applies for pvp type combat
units.translation: 仅影响 PvP 战斗

units.source: When enabled we will show damage numbers in a form of holograms when damaging players
units.translation: 启用后，攻击玩家时通过全息图显示伤害数字

units.source: Prevents damage from players with god mode enabled
units.translation: 阻止上帝模式玩家造成伤害

units.source: Can be bypassed with cmi.pvp.godBypass permission node
units.translation: 可通过 cmi.pvp.godBypass 绕过

units.source: Informs player that he cant damage players while in god mode
units.translation: 提示玩家无法在上帝模式下伤害其他玩家

units.source: When set to true players will be only able to use commands defined in the list
units.translation: 设为 true，战斗中只能执行列表中的命令

units.source: When set to true AllowedCommands become black list which will define which commands player cant use
units.translation: 设为 true，AllowedCommands 改为黑名单，用于指定战斗中禁止的命令

units.source: Can be bypassed with cmi.pvp.MFlyBypass permission node
units.translation: 可通过 cmi.pvp.MFlyBypass 绕过

units.source: This only applies for pve type combat
units.translation: 仅影响 PvE 战斗

units.source: When enabled we will include damage from environmental damage into mob combat timer
units.translation: 启用后，环境伤害也会触发生物战斗计时

units.source: This can include damage from cactus, magma blocks, suffocation, burning, fall damage and similar
units.translation: 包括仙人掌、岩浆块、窒息、燃烧和摔落等伤害

units.source: When enabled we will show damage numbers in a form of holograms when damaging mobs
units.translation: 启用后，攻击生物时通过全息图显示伤害数字

units.source: Can be bypassed with cmi.pve.godBypass permission node
units.translation: 可通过 cmi.pve.godBypass 绕过

units.source: Informs player that he cant damage mobs while in god mode
units.translation: 提示玩家无法在上帝模式下伤害生物

units.source: Example: - 'cmi heal:100.5:true'
units.translation: 示例：- 'cmi heal:100.5:true'

units.source: While defining command avoid using alias and use full command name
units.translation: 设置命令时，使用完整名称，不要使用别名

units.source: Cost can be any positive number
units.translation: 费用可为任意正数

units.source: After cost you can use true/false to define if you want to inform player when money is charged after using command or not
units.translation: 费用后的第一个 true/false，决定执行命令扣费时是否提示玩家

units.source: Second true/false will define if we confirmation from players by typing command again or clicking on a message in chat before performing it and charging for it. This will include information about command cost. By default players will be asked for confirmation
units.translation: 第二个 true/false 决定执行和扣费前是否需要再次输入命令或点击聊天消息确认；会显示费用，默认要求确认

units.source: Attention! Don't use alias command name, use full base command, for example /heal is not valid, use /cmi heal otherwise you will be risking in allowing players to perform base command without a charge
units.translation: 注意！使用完整基础命令，例如不要用 /heal，要用 /cmi heal，否则可能允许玩家免费执行基础命令

units.source: On another hand you can use custom alias commands in here
units.translation: 也可以在此填写自定义别名命令

units.source: Keep in mind: base CMI commands will double check if command was successfully performed before charging money, while custom alias will charge money despite commands success
units.translation: CMI 基础命令会检查是否执行成功，再决定扣费；自定义别名则不论成功与否都会扣费

units.source: So in example of /cmi warp player will not be charged if he enters incorrect warp name, while having custom alias will charge money even if command fails to be performed
units.translation: 例如 /cmi warp 输入错误传送点名称时不扣费，但自定义别名即使执行失败也会收费

units.source: When enabled mob heads will have bigger chance to drop when using tools with looting enchantment
units.translation: 启用后，使用带抢夺附魔的工具时，提高生物头颅掉落概率

units.source: Value is in % and it will add appropriate percentage to current drop chance by using drop chance itself
units.translation: 数值为百分比，按当前掉落概率计算额外增幅

units.source: For example player who has head drop change of 1% with looting 3 which has 30% bonus will have 1.3% as end value (default values)
units.translation: 例如基础概率 1%，抢夺 3 提供 30% 加成，最终为 1.3%，这是默认值

units.source: This only applies for monster heads
units.translation: 仅影响怪物头颅

units.source: You can add as many levels as you want, simply duplicate line and set new number, in example
units.translation: 可复制条目添加任意等级，例如

units.source: Defines if you want to use default head lore which will be used in case head doesnt have defined lore
units.translation: 是否使用默认头颅描述，用于未单独设置描述的头颅

units.source: Default lore used when head doesnt have defined head lore set
units.translation: 头颅未设置描述时使用的默认描述

units.source: Defines if you want to use player head lore
units.translation: 是否使用玩家头颅描述

units.source: Lore used for player head drops
units.translation: 玩家头颅掉落时使用的描述

units.source: Global variables can be used for simple identification who was killed and who killed player
units.translation: 可用全局变量，便于标识死者与击杀者

units.source: Aditionally placeholders can be used too, but we will use victim as source for their translation if placeholder requires source player
units.translation: 也支持占位符；需要玩家对象的占位符会以死者为解析对象

units.source: Defines if we should maintain heads custom name when head is placed and then broken
units.translation: 头颅放置后再破坏时，是否保留自定义名称

units.source: Vanilla minecraft will remove any custom information about head when you place it, this can help out to maintain data
units.translation: 原版在放置头颅时会丢弃自定义信息，此项可帮助保留数据

units.source: Percentage from 0 to 100 for head to be dropped. Decimals are acceptable, like 0.2
units.translation: 头颅掉落概率，范围为 0 到 100，可填 0.2 等小数

units.source: 100 will mean that head will be dropped every time player kills another player
units.translation: 100 表示每次玩家击杀其他玩家时都会掉头颅

units.source: 1 will mean that there is 1% that player will drop head if he is killed by another player
units.translation: 1 表示玩家被另一名玩家击杀时，有 1% 概率掉头颅

units.source: Percentage from 0 to 100 for lowering chance in getting second head of same player
units.translation: 再次获得同一玩家头颅时，降低掉落概率的百分比，范围为 0 到 100

units.source: This will reset on each server restart
units.translation: 每次服务器重启后重置

units.source: When enabled player heads will have bigger chance to drop when using tools with looting enchantment
units.translation: 启用后，使用带抢夺附魔的工具时，提高玩家头颅掉落概率

units.source: This only applies for player heads
units.translation: 仅影响玩家头颅

units.source: List of worlds where we should drop player heads. Keep it empty if you want to include all possible ones
units.translation: 允许掉落玩家头颅的世界，留空包含全部世界

units.source: Enables custom mob heads dropping from mobs with particular chance
units.translation: 允许生物按指定概率掉落自定义头颅

units.source: Check CustomHeads.yml for customization by entityType
units.translation: 按实体类型的详细设置见 CustomHeads.yml

units.source: List of worlds where we should drop mob heads. Keep it empty if you want to include all possible ones
units.translation: 允许掉落生物头颅的世界，留空包含全部世界

units.source: Custom heads of every entity
units.translation: 各实体的自定义头颅

units.source: You can have as many custom heads as you want
units.translation: 可添加任意数量的自定义头颅

units.source: Format is [dropChance]:[texture]
units.translation: 格式为 [dropChance]:[texture]

units.source: Drop chance is for that particular head
units.translation: 此处概率仅针对这一种头颅

units.source: While you have separate global drop chance for particular entity type
units.translation: 每种实体类型另有独立的全局掉落概率

units.source: Strongly recommend to have at least one head at 100% as in another case there will be a chance to not get a head even if player should
units.translation: 强烈建议至少有一种头颅的概率为 100%，否则即使触发了实体的掉落，也可能没有头颅产出

units.source: You can find custom textures online
units.translation: 可在网上查找自定义贴图

units.source: If you have more then one possible head for one entity type, then it will be randomized
units.translation: 同一实体有多种可用头颅时，随机选择

units.source: Custom mob head can be defined by using format like [chance]:[HeadName]:c-[options]:lore{"[lore]"}:[texture]
units.translation: 自定义头颅格式：[chance]:[HeadName]:c-[options]:lore{"[lore]"}:[texture]

units.source: More information and some better examples can be found at www.zrips.net/cmi/extra/custom-mob-heads/
units.translation: 详细说明和示例见 www.zrips.net/cmi/extra/custom-mob-heads/

units.source: Optionally you can shorten out texture string by removing first part which is eyJ0ZXh0dXJlcyI6eyJTS0lOIjp7InVybCI6Imh0dHA6Ly90ZXh0dXJlcy5taW5lY3JhZnQubmV0L3RleHR1cmUv which by itself will be added automatically if not present
units.translation: 可省略贴图字符串开头的 eyJ0ZXh0dXJlcyI6eyJTS0lOIjp7InVybCI6Imh0dHA6Ly90ZXh0dXJlcy5taW5lY3JhZnQubmV0L3RleHR1cmUv；缺失时会自动补上

units.source: storage method, can be MySQL or sqlite
units.translation: 存储方式：MySQL 或 sqlite

units.source: ATTENTION! DON'T USE SAME DATABASE TABLES FOR MORE THEN ONE SERVER, YOU WILL HAVE UNEXPECTED ISSUES. EACH SERVER SHOULD HAVE ITS OWN DATABASE TABLE SETUP
units.translation: 注意！多台服务器不要共用同一组数据库表，否则可能出现非预期问题。每台服务器应使用独立的数据表

units.source: Requires Mysql.
units.translation: 需要 MySQL

units.source: Valid characters are a-z 0-9 and _
units.translation: 允许字符为 a-z、0-9 和 _

units.source: If you have no clue what these values do, then keep it at default values
units.translation: 不了解这些数值的用途时，请保留默认值

units.source: Auto save interval in seconds
units.translation: 自动保存间隔，单位为秒

units.source: This will define how often to write down data into data base
units.translation: 决定多久向数据库写入一次数据

units.source: Save operation will not be performed if there is no changes to save
units.translation: 没有数据变化时，不执行保存

units.source: !ATTENTION! Keep it in low numbers, around 60 seconds
units.translation: 注意！请保持较短间隔，例如约 60 秒

units.source: Minimal interval is 10 seconds
units.translation: 最短间隔为 10 秒

units.source: Player data will be recorded straight after he logs out, without any delay
units.translation: 玩家退出后立即保存数据，不等待下一次自动保存

units.source: EXPERIMENTAL. This is not fully tested yet and some minor issues can happen when ussing on bungee network
units.translation: 实验性选项，尚未充分测试，在 BungeeCord 网络中可能出现小问题

units.source: Player data will be loaded from database each time player joins server
units.translation: 玩家每次加入时，都从数据库加载数据

units.source: When its set to false then precached data will be uses which is more efficient
units.translation: 设为 false，使用预缓存数据，效率更高

units.source: Enable or disable custom death messages
units.translation: 开启或关闭自定义死亡消息

units.source: Check DeathMessages dirrectory for message options
units.translation: 消息设置见 DeathMessages 目录

units.source: Not all death situations might be included and future updates might be needed
units.translation: 可能尚未覆盖所有死亡情况，后续仍需更新

units.source: Report any missing death situation you encountered to github issue section with exact way to reproduce death situation
units.translation: 遇到缺失的死亡情况时，请在 GitHub Issues 提交，并提供准确复现方式

units.source: Defines number of players from which to automatically start hiding death messages
units.translation: 在线人数达到多少时，自动隐藏死亡消息

units.source: Range in blocks we should broadcast players death message
units.translation: 死亡消息的广播范围，单位为方块

units.source: Setting this to any range will automatically exclude players in other worlds
units.translation: 设置范围后，自动排除其他世界的玩家

units.source: Where should we should death message
units.translation: 死亡消息的显示位置

units.source: Options: plain, actionBar
units.translation: 可用值：plain、actionBar

units.source: List of worlds where deaths from them are never announced
units.translation: 不广播其中死亡事件的世界

units.source: Keep it at low number, as player always can try again after delay
units.translation: 建议保持较小值，因为玩家冷却结束后可以重试

units.source: List of biomes to exclude from random teleportation
units.translation: 随机传送排除的生物群系

units.source: If this set to true we will generate random teleport default settings for all detected worlds
units.translation: 设为 true，为检测到的全部世界生成默认随机传送设置

units.source: Setting to false will no longer generate world setups, but you can add them manually if needed
units.translation: 设为 false，不再自动生成世界设置，但仍可手动添加

units.source: World name to use this feature. Add another one with appropriate name to enable random teleportation
units.translation: 使用此功能的世界名称。按相应世界名称添加条目，即可启用随机传送

units.source: Amount of times we should try to find valid location. This is mostly directly correlates with amount of chunks we will check
units.translation: 寻找有效位置的尝试次数，通常直接影响检查的区块数量

units.source: If set to 0 we will use default MaxTries set at the top of file
units.translation: 设为 0，使用文件顶部的默认 MaxTries

units.source: Cooldown when looking for valid location, if set to 0 we will use default Cooldown set at the top of file
units.translation: 寻找有效位置的冷却时间，设为 0 使用文件顶部的默认 Cooldown

units.source: Max coordinate to teleport, setting to 1000, player can be teleported between -1000 and 1000 blocks between defined center location
units.translation: 相对中心位置的最大坐标范围，例如 1000 表示中心两侧 -1000 到 1000 格

units.source: For example having centerX at 2000 and centerZ at 3000 while MaxRange is set to 1500 we will teleport player between x:500;z:1500 and x:3500;z:4500 coordinates
units.translation: 例如 centerX 为 2000、centerZ 为 3000、MaxRange 为 1500，传送范围为 x:500;z:1500 到 x:3500;z:4500

units.source: If maxcord set to 1000 and mincord to 500, then player can be teleported between -1000 to -500 and 1000 to 500 coordinates
units.translation: 例如 maxcord 为 1000、mincord 为 500，范围为 -1000 到 -500，以及 1000 到 500 的坐标区间

units.source: Shape of area player can be teleported into. If your map is square shaped then keep this at false
units.translation: 随机传送区域的形状。地图为方形时保持 false

units.source: With this option we will only attempt to teleport player on highest block and ignore any cave teleportations
units.translation: 只尝试传送到最高方块，忽略洞穴位置

units.source: Exception when you have Ignore.Leaves set to true which will attempt to place player under the tree leaves if there is any empty space
units.translation: 例外是 Ignore.Leaves 为 true 时，会在树叶下方有空位时尝试将玩家放在叶下

units.source: When enabled player will be able to random teleport at specied world while being in another one
units.translation: 启用后，允许从其他世界随机传送到此世界

units.source: When enabled player will be required to have (cmi.randomteleport.world) permission node to random teleport inside this world
units.translation: 启用后，随机传送到此世界需要 cmi.randomteleport.world 权限

units.source: Location detection limitations on Y axis. If you want to minimize teleportations underground then you can set this value to 63
units.translation: 寻找位置时的 Y 轴限制。若要减少传送到地下的情况，可设为 63

units.source: Higher limitations might increase time needed to find valid one
units.translation: 较高限制可能增加寻找有效位置的时间

units.source: When enabled we will not teleport player to single block spaces which forces player into crawl mode
units.translation: 启用后，不将玩家传送到会强制进入爬行状态的一格高空间

units.source: List of floor materials we should ignore when random teleporting
units.translation: 随机传送时排除的地面材质

units.source: List of biomes we should ignore when random teleporting
units.translation: 随机传送时排除的生物群系

units.source: Keeping it empty will include all of them
units.translation: 留空表示包含全部

units.source: If this is empty and ExcludedBiomes contains set biomes then we will use it
units.translation: 此项为空且 ExcludedBiomes 有设置时，使用 ExcludedBiomes

units.source: List of biomes we should look for when random teleporting
units.translation: 随机传送时优先查找的生物群系

units.source: If this contains biome names then we will ignore Ignore.Biomes section
units.translation: 填写生物群系名称后，忽略 Ignore.Biomes

units.source: Main server folder spigot.yml and check that stats saving prevention its set to false stats->disable-saving: false
units.translation: 检查服务器根目录的 spigot.yml，确认未关闭统计保存，即 stats->disable-saving: false

units.source: Player will get default rank group depending on set permission node cmi.rank.[groupName]
units.translation: 按 cmi.rank.[groupName] 权限给玩家分配默认等级组

units.source: Not enabled ranks will be ignored
units.translation: 未启用的等级会被忽略

units.source: DisplayName section is optional and it will be used to represent rank ingame. This is NOT defining required permission node and you still need to use node name to rankup to this rank
units.translation: DisplayName 为可选显示名称，只用于游戏内显示；不会改变权限节点，晋级仍使用节点名称

units.source: DefaultRank section defines if player can be assigned to this rank if he don't have any. There can be more than one default rank, and depending on permision node, first rank will be assigned to that player when needed
units.translation: DefaultRank 决定玩家无等级时能否分配到此等级。可设置多个默认等级，按权限分配第一个符合条件的等级

units.source: PermissionRequirement section defines list of permissions player should have to rankup to that rank. Optional - For each permission node you can add its name which will be shown in /cmi rankinfo with : In example cmi.command.fly:Fly
units.translation: PermissionRequirement 是晋级所需权限列表。可在节点后用 : 添加显示名称，供 /cmi rankinfo 显示，例如 cmi.command.fly:Fly

units.source: McMMORequirement section defines list of McMMO skills and levels player should have to rankup to that rank.
units.translation: McMMORequirement 是晋级所需的 McMMO 技能与等级

units.source: AureliumRequirement section defines list of Aurelium skills and levels player should have to rankup to that rank.
units.translation: AureliumRequirement 是晋级所需的 Aurelium 技能与等级

units.source: AuraSkillsRequirement section defines list of Aura skills and levels player should have to rankup to that rank.
units.translation: AuraSkillsRequirement 是晋级所需的 Aura 技能与等级

units.source: McMMO and Aurelium sections can use skill name as Power to indicate total sum of all skills
units.translation: McMMO 和 Aurelium 中，可用技能名称 Power 表示全部技能等级总和

units.source: JobsRequirement section defines list of Jobs and levels player should have to rankup to that rank.
units.translation: JobsRequirement 是晋级所需的职业及等级

units.source: ItemRequirement section defines list of items player should have to rankup to that rank. Items will be taken after succesfull rankup from players inventory.
units.translation: ItemRequirement 是晋级所需物品，成功晋级后从玩家物品栏扣除

units.source: AutoRankup section defines if player will be auto ranked to this rank if possible. Keep in mind that if there is more than one legit rankup, player will have to confirm to which rank he wants to rankup
units.translation: AutoRankup 决定满足条件时是否自动晋级。若有多个可选等级，玩家仍需确认要晋升到哪一个

units.source: RankupConfirmation section defines if you want to add additional confirmation for this rankup. Usefull to avoid unintentional rankups. Keep in mind that autorankup will request confirmation for rankup to this rank even if there is only one legit rankup option
units.translation: RankupConfirmation 增加一次确认，避免误晋级。开启后，即使只有一个有效选项，自动晋级也需要确认

units.source: NextRanks is list of possible next ranks from this rank. Can be one or can be dozens. Keep in mind that each rank requirements will be shown in chat and it can clutter quite allot if there is bunch of them at once
units.translation: NextRanks 为当前等级的后续等级列表，可有一个或多个。各等级要求都会显示在聊天中，数量过多可能刷屏

units.source: MoneyCost defines how much player will have to pay to rankup to this rank
units.translation: MoneyCost：晋级所需金钱

units.source: ExpCost defines how much player will have to pay in exp to rankup to this rank
units.translation: ExpCost：晋级所需经验

units.source: Votes defines how much player will need to have votes to rankup to this rank
units.translation: Votes：晋级所需投票数

units.source: Commands is list which will be performed on rankup. Can be additional actions, like message broadcast or anything alse
units.translation: Commands：晋级时执行的命令，可用于广播或其他操作

units.source: Main section is StatsRequirements and it can have allot of different values in it:
units.translation: 主要要求位于 StatsRequirements，可填写多种统计值：

units.source: In general format goes like this [mainStat](:optionalSubStat):amount
units.translation: 通常格式为 [mainStat](:optionalSubStat):amount

units.source: Alternatively you can combine multiple ones into one, keep in mind that this requires for mainStat to be the same [mainStat](:optionalSubStat)(;SecondaryOptionalSubStat):amount
units.translation: 也可组合多个子项，但 mainStat 必须相同，格式为 [mainStat](:optionalSubStat)(;SecondaryOptionalSubStat):amount

units.source: In example MonsterKills:100 will require from player to have 100 monster kills while MonsterKills:Zombie:100 will require to have 100 zombie kills. Both of them can be used if needed.
units.translation: 例如 MonsterKills:100 要求击杀 100 只怪物，MonsterKills:Zombie:100 要求击杀 100 只僵尸，需要时可同时使用

units.source: Defined percentage for item to break when salvaging it
units.translation: 分解时物品损坏的概率

units.source: Value can be from 0 to 100, where 100 means that each time player extract enchant, item breaks
units.translation: 取值为 0 到 100，100 表示每次提取附魔都会损坏物品

units.source: This can allow player to extract enchantments without breaking item itself
units.translation: 可让玩家提取附魔时不破坏物品本身

units.source: Set it to 100 if you want to always break item
units.translation: 设为 100，每次都损坏物品

units.source: Keep in mind that broken item will go throw ingredient return process
units.translation: 物品损坏后，仍会进入材料返还流程

units.source: Attention! Items without enchants will have 100% break chance
units.translation: 注意！没有附魔的物品，损坏概率为 100%

units.source: Adds extra chance to break item depending on how many enchants item has
units.translation: 根据附魔数量，额外增加物品损坏概率

units.source: In example having base chance of 8% and having this set to 2 while having item with 3 enchants will result into 8+(2*3)=14% chance to break item
units.translation: 例如基础概率 8%，此项为 2，物品有 3 个附魔，则损坏概率为 8+(2*3)=14%

units.source: Adds extra chance to break item depending on enchant level
units.translation: 根据附魔等级，额外增加物品损坏概率

units.source: This will take into consideration enchantment max and current levels
units.translation: 按附魔当前等级与最高等级的比例计算

units.source: Having this set to 7.5 means, that enchantment at max level will have 7.5% extra chance to to break item
units.translation: 例如设为 7.5，满级附魔额外增加 7.5% 损坏概率

units.source: But if you have sharpness 2 which has max level of 5, then only 3% fail chance will be added
units.translation: 锋利 2 的最高等级为 5，此时只增加 3% 失败概率

units.source: Defines in percentage a max chance to break item when extracting enchants
units.translation: 提取附魔时，物品损坏概率的百分比上限

units.source: This can limit chance to particular one in case it gets to 100% and it would always break
units.translation: 避免总概率达到 100% 后，每次都损坏物品

units.source: Value between 0 and 100 which defines extra fail chance when items doesnt have max durability
units.translation: 物品未满耐久度时，额外增加的失败概率，范围为 0 到 100

units.source: Having this set to 50 will mean that item at 1 left durability will have fail chance increase by 50%
units.translation: 设为 50，物品只剩 1 点耐久度时，失败概率增加 50%

units.source: Items which are not damaged will not experience any fail chance increase
units.translation: 未损坏的物品不会增加失败概率

units.source: When set to true, items durability will be taken into consideration when extracting ingredients
units.translation: 设为 true，提取材料时考虑物品耐久度

units.source: In example if item has 100 max durability and current is at 50, then only half of ingredients will be considered for extraction
units.translation: 例如最大耐久度 100、当前 50，只将一半材料纳入提取

units.source: This doesnt mean that player gets 50% of them, it only means that half of possible ingredients will go throw IngredientReturn process
units.translation: 不代表一定返还 50% 材料，而是只有一半材料会进入 IngredientReturn 返还流程

units.source: Defines in percentage a max chance to return ingredients of item if it fails extraction process
units.translation: 提取失败时，返还物品材料的最大概率，单位为百分比

units.source: This will apply for each ingredient that item has
units.translation: 分别对每一份材料进行判断

units.source: Recipe to make that item should exist in database, or it will not return any ingredients
units.translation: 数据库中必须存在对应合成配方，否则不返还材料

units.source: Adds base chance to fail enchantment extraction
units.translation: 提取附魔失败的基础概率

units.source: When enchantment fails, player will not get enchant book with appropriate enchantment
units.translation: 失败时，玩家不会获得对应附魔书

units.source: Adds extra chance to fail enchantment extraction depending on enchantment level
units.translation: 根据附魔等级，额外增加提取失败概率

units.source: Having this set to 75 means, that enchantment at max level will have 75% chance to fail extraction process
units.translation: 例如设为 75，满级附魔有 75% 概率提取失败

units.source: But if you have sharpness 2 which has max level of 5, then only 30% chance to fail will get applied
units.translation: 锋利 2 的最高等级为 5，此时只应用 30% 失败概率

units.source: While enchants like Aquaaffinity will always have max fail chance as you can only have it at level 1
units.translation: 水下速掘等只有 1 级的附魔，始终使用最高失败概率

units.source: Defines in percentage a max chance to fail enchantment extraction
units.translation: 提取附魔失败的最大概率，单位为百分比

units.source: This can limit chance to particular one in case it gets to 100% and it would always fail
units.translation: 避免总概率达到 100% 后，每次都失败

units.source: Defines a chance lowering enchant level if it fails extraction
units.translation: 提取失败后降低附魔等级的概率

units.source: This is secondary step when extraction fails and will only apply when it does
units.translation: 这是提取失败后的第二步，仅在失败时发生

units.source: If Enchant is at level 1 already, then player will not get enchanted book at all
units.translation: 附魔已经为 1 级时，不会获得附魔书

units.source: If you want to avoid lowering level of enchant when it fails extraction, set this to 100
units.translation: 若想避免提取失败时降低附魔等级，设为 100

units.source: If you want to always lower level down when extracting enchantments, then set EnchantExtractionFail.Base to 100 and set this to 100
units.translation: 若想每次提取都降低附魔等级，将 EnchantExtractionFail.Base 和此项都设为 100

units.source: Will adjust level lowering chance depending on enchant level to defined max amount at max level
units.translation: 按附魔等级调整降级概率，满级时达到指定最大值

units.source: This will mean that higher levels will have higher chance to be lowered
units.translation: 附魔等级越高，被降级的概率越高

units.source: Will adjust level lower chance depending on enchant level to defined max amount at max level
units.translation: 按附魔等级调整降级概率，满级时达到指定最大值

units.source: Defined base cost of extraction. Set to 0 if you want to make it free
units.translation: 提取基础费用，设为 0 免费

units.source: Extra cost which depends on enchantment worth which can be defined with /cmi setenchantworth
units.translation: 根据附魔价值追加费用，价值可通过 /cmi setenchantworth 设置

units.source: This value is in percentage from worth value of that each enchantment and item
units.translation: 此值为各项附魔及物品价值的百分比

units.source: So if you have base cost of 100, extra cost of 5% and you are trying to extract sharpness 5 which worth is 1000 and item sell hand worth is 100, then you will have to pay 155 for extraction process
units.translation: 例如基础费用为 100、附加费用为 5%，提取价值 1000 的锋利 5，物品 sell hand 价值为 100，则总费用为 155

units.source: When enabled we will allow scavenging of items which doesn't have valid recipe for ingredient return process
units.translation: 启用后，允许分解没有有效材料返还配方的物品

units.source: This only applies in cases when we can return enchants to player, otherwise it doesn't allow you to scavenge item
units.translation: 仅在还能返还附魔时允许，否则仍禁止分解

units.source: List of materials to block from being scavenged
units.translation: 禁止分解的材质列表

units.source: When set to true, balck list becomes whitelist and will allow scavanging of items defined in a blacklist only
units.translation: 设为 true，黑名单改为白名单，只允许分解列表中的物品

units.source: When set to false while player have open scavange UI they will not be able to pickup item from ground
units.translation: 设为 false，玩家打开分解界面时不能拾取地面物品

units.source: When enabled items, likes swords, after being salvagted if they dint broke then their repair cost will be reset so players can enchant it as like its a new one instead of making it to dificult to be enchanted
units.translation: 启用后，剑等物品在分解后未损坏时，重置其铁砧修复费用，使其可像新物品一样继续附魔，避免费用过高

units.source: Scheduler file where you can set commands to be performed in regular intervals or in particular time
units.translation: 定时任务文件，可设置固定间隔或指定时间执行的命令

units.source: Enabled: (true/false) only schedulers which are enabled will be included
units.translation: Enabled：（true/false）只运行已启用的定时任务

units.source: There can be 2 types, performed in regular time intervals (in seconds) or on particular time
units.translation: 有两种类型：按固定秒数间隔执行，或在指定时间执行

units.source: Delay: (number) defines how long to wait between each action, 600 means that actions will be performed every 10 minutes
units.translation: Delay：（数字）两次执行的间隔；600 表示每 10 分钟执行一次

units.source: Randomize: (true/false) if set to true, then only one and random of defined commands will be used. Commands will not repeat untill all of them got used up. Usefull for repeating random announcements
units.translation: Randomize：（true/false）每次随机选择一条命令，全部用完前不重复，适合循环随机公告

units.source: DuplicateRandomize: (true/false) if set to true, then only one and random of defined commands will be used. Commands might repeat. Usefull for repeating random announcements
units.translation: DuplicateRandomize：（true/false）每次随机选择一条命令，允许重复，适合循环随机公告

units.source: SingleLinear: (true/false) if set to true, then only one of defined commands will be used in a row without repeating until all of them have been executed. Usefull in cases when it needs to be shown in exact order one by one
units.translation: SingleLinear：（true/false）每次按顺序执行一条，全部执行完前不重复，适合必须依次显示的内容

units.source: PerformOn: section will define particular times when perform commands. First of name should be defined and then additional time frames should be given
units.translation: PerformOn：指定执行时间，先填写条目名称，再设置时间范围

units.source: It can have: Month, Day, Hour, Minute, Second sections. All of them in number format and hours uses 24 hour format
units.translation: 可用字段为 Month、Day、Hour、Minute、Second，均使用数字，小时采用 24 小时制

units.translation: 示例

units.source: You can use week day names to indicate at which day in a week this sheduler should be performed. Example - Day: Monday
units.translation: 可用星期名称指定执行日期，例如 - Day: Monday

units.source: FirstMonthDay or LastMonthDay can be used to indicate at which month day this scheduler should be performed. This replaces Day section. Example - FirstMonthDay: Friday which will trigger scheduler at first friday of the month
units.translation: 可用 FirstMonthDay 或 LastMonthDay 指定在每月的哪一天执行

units.source: This will set commands to be performed on 4 a clock in morning and at 22:30. Good way to control server backups when there is less players online
units.translation: 此示例在凌晨 4 点和 22:30 执行，适合在在线人数较少时备份服务器

units.source: Repeat: (true/false) if set to false, action will be performed only once other wise it will be repeated all the time in intervals or on particular time
units.translation: Repeat：（true/false）设为 false，只执行一次；否则按间隔或指定时间持续重复执行

units.source: MinPlayers: (amount) Will limit minimum player amount there should be online when command performe
units.translation: MinPlayers：（人数）执行命令所需的最低在线人数

units.source: MinPlayersCommands: List of commands to be performed when online player amount is under specified limit
units.translation: MinPlayersCommands：在线人数低于要求时执行的命令列表

units.source: MaxPlayers: (amount) Will skip scheduler if there is more than defined amount of players
units.translation: MaxPlayers：（人数）在线人数高于此值时跳过任务

units.source: Feedback: (true/false) if set to false will not show feedback message in console in case there is not enough players to perform this schedule
units.translation: Feedback：（true/false）设为 false，人数不足而跳过任务时，不在控制台提示

units.source: DontTranslatePlaceholders: (true/false) if set to true we will not translate placeholders inside commands before sending them to later processing
units.translation: DontTranslatePlaceholders：（true/false）设为 true，命令交给后续处理前，不预先解析其中占位符

units.source: This defaults to false and placeholders will be translated before hand
units.translation: 默认 false，会提前解析占位符

units.source: Exception for delay! specialized command variable which always gets translated before hand
units.translation: 例外是 delay! 特殊指令参数，其中占位符始终提前解析

units.source: Commands: List of commands to be performed when time is correct.
units.translation: Commands：到达指定时间时执行的命令列表

units.source: You can multiple commands defined in single line, separate each one with ;; for example: command1;;command2;;command3
units.translation: 同一行可写多条命令，使用 ;; 分隔，例如 command1;;command2;;command3

units.source: If command starts with msg! and then player name is given, simple message will be sent to that player if he is online.
units.translation: 以 msg! 开头并填写玩家名称时，向该在线玩家发送普通消息

units.source: If command starts with broadcast! then message will be sent to everyone on server in simple manear
units.translation: 以 broadcast! 开头时，向服务器所有人发送普通广播

units.source: If command starts with actionbar! then all players will get action bar message defined after this variable
units.translation: 以 actionbar! 开头时，向所有玩家发送后面的动作栏消息

units.source: If command starts with title! then all players will get title message defined after this variable
units.translation: 以 title! 开头时，向所有玩家发送后面的标题

units.source: If command starts with subtitle! then all players will get subtitle message defined after this variable
units.translation: 以 subtitle! 开头时，向所有玩家发送后面的副标题

units.source: If command starts with kickall! then all players will be kicked from server with defined message. Usefull before server stop.
units.translation: 以 kickall! 开头时，用指定原因踢出全部玩家，适合停服前使用

units.source: If command starts with perm:[permissionNode]! then command will get performed if player has permission node. This will not work when we don't know who is target player. In example: perm:cmi.announce.vip! broadcast! Hello vip guys
units.translation: 以 perm:[permissionNode]! 开头时，只在玩家有权限时执行；无法确定目标玩家时不生效。例如 perm:cmi.announce.vip! broadcast! Hello vip guys

units.source: If command starts with moneycost:[amount]! then command will get performed if player has enough money.
units.translation: 以 moneycost:[amount]! 开头时，只在玩家余额足够时执行

units.source: If command starts with expcost:[amount]! then command will get performed if player has enough exp.
units.translation: 以 expcost:[amount]! 开头时，只在玩家经验足够时执行

units.source: If command starts with allPlayers! then command will get performed by using everyones who is online name. Command itself need to contain [allPlayers] to indicate where player name needs to be added
units.translation: 以 allPlayers! 开头时，对所有在线玩家执行。命令本身需要包含 [allPlayers]，指定玩家名称插入位置

units.source: Insert line with 'delay! 5' to perform rest of commands after 5 seconds from scheduler trigger. This allows to create in example counter before server stop. Check example.
units.translation: 插入 'delay! 5'，可在任务触发 5 秒后执行后续命令，适合停服倒计时等，见示例

units.source: [randomPlayer] placeholder can be used to get random online player name who don't have cmi.scheduler.exclude permission node. This can be used to give rewards for random players on particular time. In example: - cmi give [randomPlayer] diamond %rand/1-5% will give rando mamount from 1 to 5 diamonds to random online player
units.translation: [randomPlayer] 选择随机在线玩家，排除拥有 cmi.scheduler.exclude 权限者。例如 - cmi give [randomPlayer] diamond %rand/1-5% 向随机玩家发放 1 到 5 颗钻石

units.source: Supports PlaceHolderAPI variables
units.translation: 支持 PlaceholderAPI 变量

units.source: More information about specialized commands can be found at https://www.zrips.net/cmi/commands/specialized/
units.translation: 特殊指令详细说明见 https://www.zrips.net/cmi/commands/specialized/

units.source: To disable tablist handling visit Modules.yml file
units.translation: 要关闭 Tab 列表处理，请到 Modules.yml 设置

units.source: Defines if we want to run tablist updater in async mode
units.translation: 是否异步更新 Tab 列表

units.source: While enabled it can increase overall performance but some plugins can have same issues handling async placeholder requests
units.translation: 启用可提高整体性能，但部分插件可能无法正常处理异步占位符请求

units.source: Enable or disable grouped format tablist's
units.translation: 开启或关闭分组 Tab 列表格式

units.source: You can save some resources by disabling this if you are not interested in grouped format tablist feature
units.translation: 不使用分组格式时，关闭可节省资源

units.source: If disabled then this will use only default format and will skip checking for custom one to save some resources if needed
units.translation: 关闭后，只使用默认格式，不再检查自定义格式，以节省资源

units.source: automatically updates tab list every x seconds for ALL online players
units.translation: 每隔 X 秒自动更新所有在线玩家的 Tab 列表

units.source: If you are using static Footer and Header you can disable this by setting to -1
units.translation: 页眉页脚为静态内容时，可设为 -1 关闭自动更新

units.source: Consider setting this to -1 if its completely enough to update on player events
units.translation: 只在玩家事件发生时更新已足够的话，也可设为 -1

units.source: When set to false we will not add header text to tablist
units.translation: 设为 false，不添加 Tab 页眉

units.source: When set to false we will not add footer text to tablist
units.translation: 设为 false，不添加 Tab 页脚

units.source: PlaceholderAPI supported for any custom variable you want to insert into this
units.translation: 支持 PlaceholderAPI 自定义变量

units.source: In addition CMI will handle some placeholders without PlaceHolderAPI
units.translation: CMI 也能自行解析部分占位符，无需 PlaceholderAPI

units.source: Full list can be checked ingame with /cmi placeholders
units.translation: 完整列表可在游戏内执行 /cmi placeholders 查看

units.source: This will define how others see players name in tab list
units.translation: 其他玩家在 Tab 列表中看到的玩家名称格式

units.source: When this set to true, in case you dint defined PlayerName, Header or Footer in GroupFormat, then default one from GeneralFormat will be used
units.translation: 设为 true，GroupFormat 未指定 PlayerName、Header 或 Footer 时，回退到 GeneralFormat 默认值

units.source: Defines custom formats to be used for players.
units.translation: 玩家自定义格式

units.source: Any player which have cmi.tablist.[number] permission node will use defined grouped format in tablist
units.translation: 拥有 cmi.tablist.[number] 权限的玩家使用对应分组格式

units.source: Id should be a number and in case player has more than one, bigger number id will be used
units.translation: ID 必须是数字，拥有多个匹配权限时使用较大的 ID

units.source: You can have as many groups as you want by increasing increment
units.translation: 递增编号即可添加任意数量的组

units.source: For 1.19.3+ servers only. Enable or disable tab list sorting. This will sort tablist by defined criteria
units.translation: 仅适用于 1.19.3+：开启或关闭 Tab 排序，按指定条件排列

units.source: In which order should we sort players
units.translation: 玩家排序条件的先后顺序

units.source: Potential options: Weight, Group, Name, NickName, Balance, World
units.translation: 可用值：Weight、Group、Name、NickName、Balance、World

units.source: Optionally add ASC or DESC for specific order for that type of ordering, for example 'Weight-DESC'
units.translation: 可添加 ASC 或 DESC 指定某项的顺序，例如 'Weight-DESC'

units.source: Weight is determined by players access to cmi.tablistweight.[value] permission node and highest value of it, for example cmi.tablistweight.5
units.translation: Weight 取玩家 cmi.tablistweight.[value] 权限中的最大值，例如 cmi.tablistweight.5

units.source: Sorting is updated at same time head and/or footer is
units.translation: 排序与页眉或页脚同时更新
